NetworkUpgrade_en.network_BREWER_desc: Wild will introduce you to the sales representative of the Red Imp Brewery, allowing you immediate and consistent access to their beer supply. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_CHEMIST_desc: Wild will introduce you to a Lower Levels Chemist who produces cheap but illegal drugs for both recreational and medical uses. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_PHARMA_desc: Wild will introduce you to the Inventory Manager for an unnamed Upper Levels Pharmacist, allowing you immediate and consistent access to legal, but hard to source, medications. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_MINER_desc: Wild will introduce you to the leader of GP Mining Coop, who will allow you to order large amounts of mineral ores. A business card will be given to you to contact this supplier.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_LANDLORD_GRACE_desc: Wild will convince the Landlord that if you missed a rent payment, it's acceptable to pay the missing rent together with the next week's rent. This is a one time favor.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_LANDLORD_GRACE_already_bought: You are already in the Landlord's good graces.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_SEC_GRACE_desc: Wild will use his political influence to ensure that if a Security Inspector finds contraband that would normally result in imprisonment, you will instead be let off with a warning. This is a one time favor.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_SEC_GRACE_already_bought: Wild has already performed this favor for you.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_INSPECTION_INFORMANT_desc: Wild will introduce you to his informant within the Security Department. As long as you pay a nightly fee, the informant will notify you of any regular Security inspection. The informant won't be able to help with any surprise inspections.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_WILD_FIXER_desc: Wild will allow you to hire his fixers. As long as you pay a nightly fee, the fixers will silence witnesses and clean up evidence not yet collected by Security, lowering your suspected crime level at an increased rate.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_EVIDENCE_REMOVAL_desc: Wild will order his security contacts to destroy all collected evidence and tamper with any ongoing investigation against you. This favor has a cooldown of {0} days.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_BUY_REFERAL_desc: Wild will agree to refer buyers from his network to your Store, if a nightly fee is paid. Additionally, more customers will be attracted to items in the display case.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_SELL_REFERAL_desc: Wild will agree to refer sellers from his network to your Store, if a nightly fee is paid.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_CRIMINEL_NETWORK_desc: Wild will agree to refer high-budget contraband buyers from his network to your Store, if a nightly fee is paid. Using this service also grants you a small amount of Black Market reputation ({0} days cooldown)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_POWER_HIJACK_desc: Your power will be supplied by an external solar panel owned by someone who (probably) doesn't need it. The nightly Power Service is now free. Current Converters are still billed, since the solar panel's output is not enough to run them, but they cost 15% less. Blackouts no longer affect your store or your Current Converters.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_COMMERCIAL_POWER_desc: Your power supply unit will be upgraded to accommodate more power. The Recharger and PowerBloc will charge {0}% quicker.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_SHOWCASE_I_desc: Your showcase will be expanded to allow more items to be displayed. {0} more customers will be visiting to buy items from the Display Case per day.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_SHOWCASE_II_desc: Your showcase will be expanded even more. {0} additional customers will be visiting to buy item from the Display Case per day.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_GUTTERFLOW_TAP_desc: Wild will connect your water line to a sewer, allowing you access to unlimited Gutterflow. The purity of the water changes every day.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RUSTWATER_TAP_desc: Wild will connect your water line to an industrial discharge pipe, allowing you access to unlimited Rustwater. The purity of the water changes every day.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RUINED_MACHINE_UNLOCK_desc: A Junker who will introduce you to scrapping ruined machines for parts will visit you the next day. (Unlocks Ruined Machine Content)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RETIRED_FARMER_desc: Immediately receive a Hydroponic Starter Kit. A retired farmer will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling seeds and hydroponic equipment. (Unlocks Advanced Farming Content.)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RETIRED_GUNSMITH_desc: Immediately receive a Gunsmith Starter Kit. A retired gunsmith will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling gun mods and ammo. (Unlocks Advanced Gunsmith Content.)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_GUN_PERMIT_I_desc: Wild will negotiate on your behalf to secure you a firearms permit usually reserved for Lower Level Merchants, allowing you to legally trade low level contraband firearms and ammunition. The permit is delivered once you reach {0} Security Reputation and revoked if it drops below 0. Security lets you keep a shotgun for self defence, once you acquired it.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_GUN_PERMIT_II_desc: Wild will negotiate on your behalf to secure you a firearms permit usually reserved for Upper Level Merchants, allowing you to legally trade mid level contraband firearms and ammunition. The permit will only be delivered after reaching at least {0} Security Reputation.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_GUN_PERMIT_III_desc: Wild will negotiate on your behalf to secure you a weapon permit usually reserved for Station Security Quartermasters, allowing you to legally trade high level contraband firearms and ammunition. The permit will only be delivered after reaching at least {0} Security Reputation.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RETIRED_CHEMIST_desc: Immediately receive a Chemist Starter Kit. A retired chemist will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling chemical supplies and equipment. (Unlocks Advanced Chemistry Content.)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_WATER_TRADER_desc: Immediately receive a Water Trading Starter Kit. A Water Trader will start visiting the Store. (Unlocks Water Trading Content.)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_MARKETPLACE_REQUESTS_desc: Wild will connect you with the Marketplace Request network, allowing you to browse and fulfill various requests from buyers. Rewards for requested items are usually higher than regular market value.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_JACKSON1_desc: Wild will convince Dr. Jackson to accept a small investment from you, permanently increasing his budget, and the available stock when visiting him. Dr. Jackson will always have Modules in stock.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_JACKSON2_desc: Wild will convince Dr. Jackson to accept another investment from you, permanently increasing his budget, and the available stock when visiting him. Dr. Jackson will always have additional Modules in stock.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RENOVATION1_desc: Wild will hire contractors to make modest renovations to the Store, improving its base attractiveness by {0} points.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RENOVATION2_desc: Wild will hire contractors to make substantial renovations to the Store, improving its base attractiveness by another {0} points.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RENOVATION3_desc: Wild will hire contractors to make transformative renovations to the Store, improving its base attractiveness by another {0} points.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_RETIRED_RANCHER_desc: Wild will refer you to a Rat Rancher who will visit you once a week. Immediately receive a Rat Ranching Starter Kit. (Unlock Rancher Content)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_WINEMAKER_desc: Immediately receive a Winemaking Starter Kit. A retired winemaker will visit you the next day and, subsequently, once a week, selling winemaking supplies and equipment. (Unlocks Winemaking Content.)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_AQUACULTURE_desc: Wild will refer you to a retired aquafarmer who will visit you once a week, selling fish farming equipment and fertilized roe. Immediately receive an Aquaculture Starter Kit. (Unlocks Aquaculture Content.)
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_AQUACULTURE_II_desc: The retired aquafarmer will also bring bigger, more profitable fish to raise on each visit. Immediately receive two young eels.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_PLANT_DNA_desc: Immediately receive a DNA manipulator, a gene scanner and blank DNA data disks. Dr. Jackson will now keep DNA manipulation equipment in stock.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_DOSSIER_UPGRADE_desc: Expand the size of the dossier.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_TRASHCAN_UPGRADE_desc: Expand the size of the trash can.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_VENDING_MACHINE_desc: A vending machine will be immediately installed in the store. Allowing goods to be sold during the night.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_VENDING_FOUNTAIN_desc: A vending fountain will be immediately installed in the store. Allowing water to be sold during the night.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_BREWER_SHAREHOLDER_desc: Buy a minor share of the Red Imp Brewery. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Thursday morning a dividend of {1} case of beer is waiting on the counter.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_MINER_SHAREHOLDER_desc: Buy a minor share of the GP Mining Coop. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Friday morning a dividend of {1} ore is waiting on the counter.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_CHEMIST_SHAREHOLDER_desc: Buy a minor share of the Lower Levels Chemist's operation. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Saturday morning a dividend of {1} street grade Dream Dust is waiting on the counter.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_PHARMA_SHAREHOLDER_desc: Buy a minor share of the Upper Level Pharmacist's practice. Their courier's wholesale discount grows by {0}%, and every Sunday morning a dividend of {1} Oxymore injectors is waiting on the counter.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_JACKSON_SPECIAL_STOCK_desc: Dr. Jackson opens on Mondays for you alone, offering a special stock of rarer items at a premium.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_HYPERTECH_SMUGGLER_desc: Joe Wild refers you to a smuggler who deals in Hypertech items, technology far beyond what the station's industry can produce. Unlocks the Hypertech Smuggler nightly service.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_ENDORSEMENT1_desc: Joe Wild personally endorses your store. Visiting customers have {0}% more budget to spend.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_ENDORSEMENT2_desc: Joe Wild talks up your store to his best contacts. Visiting customers have another {0}% more budget to spend.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_ENDORSEMENT3_desc: Joe Wild puts his own name behind your store. Visiting customers have another {0}% more budget to spend.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_WILD_FIXER2_desc: Wild assigns you his more experienced fixers. They clear evidence faster, so your suspected crime level drops more each night. The nightly fee increases.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_WILD_FIXER3_desc: Wild puts his best crew on your store. Witnesses forget, evidence disappears, and your suspected crime level drops even faster each night. The nightly fee increases.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_POWER_HIJACK2_desc: Wild's crew splices a bigger solar array into your line. It now carries part of your Current Converters' load: they cost {0}% less to run.
NetworkUpgrade_en.network_POWER_HIJACK3_desc: Wild's crew taps a whole rooftop of panels for you. Your Current Converters now cost {0}% less to run in total.

Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro_3: The GREATEST scavenger in the Lower Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro_4: You are lucky. Georgio has brought you his latest find.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro_5: Look! Relics from an ancient alien civilization...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro_done: Until my next great find, my friend!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_arrest_sec_1: Keep it down, old man. You're coming with us.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro2_3: Today, Georgio brings you an invention all of his own...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro2_4: Georgio wanted to give you the chance to be the first to stock it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_intro2_5: Gaze upon... the water of tomorrow!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio2_2: I have found 100% genuine heminwai cigarettes,
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio2_4: Special price for you my friend.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio2_arrest_sec: Whatever, you are coming with us.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio3_3: Georgio has been scavenging on the Upper Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio3_player_1: What is there to scavenge on the Upper Levels?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio3_5: For you? Georgio give 25% off for everything.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio3_done_2: More riches Georgio shall bring you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio3_arrest_client: Oh no no no, not again!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio3_arrest_sec_1: Hey! there's the old man who broke into the women's bath house in the Upper Levels!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_3: See what Georgio has for you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_6: Good scavs never reveal his spots!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_8: Georgio can always find another buyer...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_accept: Aha! Georgio knew you would like it!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_arrest_client: What? Did you snitch on Georgio?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_arrest_sec_1: There you are. You're under arrest.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio4_arrest_sec_2: How do you keep breaking into the evidence room?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_nuclear_1: Georgio is a good friend, no?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_nuclear_2: He sees you forgetting your stuff at the Dumping Grounds last night...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_nuclear_3: Does he scavenge? No! He brings it back for you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_3: He is building a space ship! To scavenge across the system...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_4: It is almost finished, but... Georgio has run out of Credits.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_5: Would you be so kind, my friend?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_accept_small_2: Take this. Georgio won't need where he is going...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_promise_1: You will be paid back with interest! Georgio guarantee!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_promise_2: See you in the stars, my friend.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_accept_large_1: You're sure? Thank you, thank you!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_accept_large_2: Here, for you. Georgio won't need it anymore...
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_decline_1: I see... no trouble, my friend.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_decline_2: Georgio will scavenge what he needs to finish the ship from the Dumping Grounds!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_arrest_client: No... please! Have mercy on Georgio!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_loan_arrest_sec_1: You have the right to remain silent.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_payback_1: No, your eyes do not deceive you!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_payback_2: Georgio has returned from the stars!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_payback_3: Here are your Credits, paid back with interest!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_payback_4: Now, Georgio will return to his ship...
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_1: Hello, I am traveling from the Core Sectors.
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_2: I want to taste every food in the galaxy.
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_3: I am buying one of each food and beverage you have.
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_4: I give you 2 days to prepare.
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_arrest_client: I JUST WANT TO BUY SOME FOODS!
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_arrest_sec: Quiet, you are coming with us!
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_returning_2: I want to taste every food in the galaxy.
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_returning_3: I am buying one of each food and beverage you have.
Dialogue_en.dialog_foodie_returning_4: I am willing to pay more for variety.
Dialogue_en.dialog_evidence_seller_1: Hello, I need to sell this quickly
Dialogue_en.dialog_evidence_seller_2: There is too much heat on me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_visit_3: But I forgot my lunchbox. You got any food?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_shot_1: Help! I need some meds, now!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_shot_2: Some guy in a grey jumpsuit jumped me!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_shot_3: I don't care if it's contraband, just give me something strong!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_shot_wrong_item: No, I need something for the pain.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_crim_1: Hey, I... uh... found some stuff.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_crim_arrest_sec_1: Hey! That's the guy who ambushed Officer Lun!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_1: Hello, I am back on duty.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_2: After a little vacation in the Medbay.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_3: This is just a routine check-in.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_4: While I'm here, I'll take some meds for pain.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_black_injector_thanks: Thanks, I guess. This stuff is expensive.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_wrong_item: No, that's not the kind of med I need.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_blackinjector_no: Synaprest? You think I have a problem?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_duty_blackinjector_no2: Even if I did, I could never afford this stuff.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_surplus_1: Hey you, it's your lucky day.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_surplus_2: Requisition has approved the sale of some... surplus items.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_surplus_5: I'm authorized to give you 33% off, if you take everything.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_surplus_arrest_sec_2: This is the missing equipment from the Armory!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_surplus_arrest_sec_3: Come quietly, Officer. You know what happens if you don't.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_drugs_1: I found some narcotics. They will be seized.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_drugs_2: Hey, don't complain. You are lucky I am not taking you in.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_arrest_sec_1: Officer Lun. What are you doing here?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_arrest_client_2: I am... uh... conducting a surprise inspection.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_arrest_sec_2: You are supposed to be on desk duty.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_arrest_sec_3: We know what you're up to.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lun_inspect_arrest_sec_4: You are under arrest for abuse of power.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_1: Oh, so this is what passes for a shop down here?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_2: Charming. I suppose it works if you've never seen a proper storefront.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_3: You there, I'll need some food until I can return to the Upper Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_4: It won't be long until they realize what blunder they made.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_5: They jailed my mother, who runs the biggest hydroponic on the station, for embezzlement.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_6: Ridiculous, half this station eats because of her!
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_intro_7: So do you have anything? Preferably fresh? Some Variety would be good.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_1: I can't believe I am stuck here.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_2: No news of my mother and they are not letting me back up.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_3: Why is this happening to me?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_4: I hate it down here, this is so unfair.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_6: looks like I will be here for a while.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_7: I found a decent room across the Commissary.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_8: It's tiny but at least it doesn't smell.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor2_9: I can't believe people live like this their whole life.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_2: I'm starting to run low on fund.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_3: They didn't let me bring much with me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_4: If I can just get back up there,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_5: I could explain everything and clear our names,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_6: and everything can go back to normal.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_7: I won't have to eat Nutrifruit for every meal.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_8: Anyways, I got some of my stuff to sell.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor4_3: A thief took the little I had left last night.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor4_5: The trial is over and they found my mother guilty.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor4_6: I am stuck here forever and mom will rot in prison.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor4_7: I can't believe I am asking this,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor4_8: but could you spare me some food?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor4_accept: Thank you so much, I won't forget this.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_3: I realized that I have to move forward,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_4: Besides, I am getting used to the bad smell.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_5: Someone in the Upper Levels probably framed my mother,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_6: I have to get my life back together and find a way to clear her,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_7: First step is to secure an income.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_8: So I figured I should scavenge in the Dumping Grounds,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_9: My roommate gave me a crash course on scavenging,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_10: I must say, there's a real sense of community here,
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor5_11: Anyways, take a look at what I got!
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_1: Hello! I am Cadet Serpico, new to Security.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_2: It's my first day on duty.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_3: I am born and raised here in the Lower Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_4: Keeping the station safe has always been my dream.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_5: Sure, some members of my family now think that I am a traitor...
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_6: But I will work hard to improve Security from within.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico1_8: I'll use them to make friends with my new colleagues.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico3_1: Oh god, I gonna need a drink.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico3_2: Security is not what I expected.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico3_3: I thought there might be a few bad Nutrifruits in the department, but this is beyond what I imagined.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico3_4: I saw officers taking bribes from Upper Levels, the Cartel and even revolutionaries!
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico3_7: Shit, I gotta go soon, just got paged.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico3_8: You got something I can take with me?
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico4_2: I just talked to my superior about the corruption I saw.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico4_3: They are opening an full internal investigation.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico4_4: I might get fast-tracked for promotion for this!
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico4_5: Can you sell me some food?
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_2: Have you seen a security cadet by the name of Serpico?
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_3: We have a warrant out for his arrest on corruption charges.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_4: He was also found drinking on duty.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_5: Make sure to report him immediately if you see him.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_6: Do not try to communicate with him.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_7: He is considered armed and dangerous.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico5_8: We are offering a reward for 300 Credits.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico6_2: They are trying to pin everything on me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico6_4: Gotta go now, they are looking for me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico6_5: I'll hide in Dumping Grounds for a bit.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_1: Hello! Good to see this shop open again.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_2: It was hard for me to find snacks after this store closed.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_3: I heard the previous shopkeeper got kidnapped in the night or something.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_4: Anyway, I am Chief Engineer Nellis,
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_6: You can just call me Nellis.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_7: I'm in charge of maintaining this old rusty station.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_8: What? Are you surprised to see a Command officer down here?
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_9: Not all of us spend all day sitting on the Bridge, you know.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_10: Unlike those Corporate Representatives and Upper-Level Councilors.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_11: People tend to forget, but most of the station's essential machinery is in the Lower Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis1_12: Anyway, you got food or what?
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_2: You got any beer or snacks?
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_3: Just finished a some major repairs down in the auxiliary life support systems.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_4: The Captain's gonna love to hear that.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_5: Lot of people down here don't think much of the Captain.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_6: Thinking he only serve the Upper Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_7: But he is really fighting to keep this station together.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_8: Between the Upper Levels always demanding more, the corporate pressure,
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_9: the lack of external help from the Republic and those radical Revolutionaries.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_10: They wouldn't understand. Only a few can see the big picture.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_11: Say what you want but the quality of live has slowly improved since he took command.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis2_12: And no major armed conflicts on the station since then.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis3_2: Got some broken modules here that I just replaced.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis3_3: I thought you might be interested in buying them.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis4_2: Just got back from a meeting with Command.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis4_3: I just can't stand those Upper Level Councilors.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis4_4: They are completely out of touch with the reality of this station.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis4_5: You won't believe half of the stuff they propose.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis4_6: Good thing the heads of departments are here to keep them in check.
Dialogue_en.dialog_nellis4_7: I am gonna need some drinks and treats to forget about that meeting.
Dialogue_en.dialog_landlord_ws_1: The previous tenant left some stuff behind.
Dialogue_en.dialog_landlord_ws_3: Want to buy any of it?
Dialogue_en.dialog_landlord_ws_4: Big discounts if you take them all, for you only.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_1: Ah, new shop in the area. Good.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_2: Too many people, too few good shops.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_3: I am Grandpa Cheng, I also run a small store in The Sector.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_4: I am supposed to get a food shipment from my supplier yesterday,
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_6: Some of my customers cannot wait. Orphans. Old workers.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_7: So I would like to buy food from you that I will resell in my store.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_8: Same price as I always sell them.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_9: Which means... I will lose money today.
Dialogue_en.dialog_cheng_intro_10: I can't raise prices, or someone will starve.

Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_1: Hey, If you haven't noticed, there's a display case on your left.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_2: Place merchandise inside the display case to attract a specific type of buyer to your shop.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_3: Place special items like Neon Signs inside the display case to attract sellers. Here, take these.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_4: Place them inside the display case and check the Clientele Interface to see who might come. Make sure to set up your display case before opening the shutter door.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_afterhours_7: So don't feel obligated to go out every night.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_outro_1: Well. I taught you all the basics.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_outro_2: The rest is up to you now.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_outro_3: Remember to buy upgrades, new machines, and expand your contacts.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_outro_4: Once you have more Credits, you can either find someone to offer you a mortgage,
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_outro_5: or buy out the store directly, if you got enough.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_outro_6: You can see the property's value on the Calendar Interface.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_upgrade_reminder_1: Hello! haven't heard from you for while.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_upgrade_reminder_2: And Dr. Jackson told me you haven't been visiting him as well.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_upgrade_reminder_3: Just a friendly reminder that we are here in case you need anything.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_upgrade_reminder_4: Here, take a look at what I got.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_grateful_1: Now that's what I call a deal. Thanks.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_grateful_2: Generous of you. I'll take it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_very_grateful_1: Wow. You're really hooking me up. Thank you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_very_grateful_2: This is incredible. I owe you one.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_very_grateful_3: Are you serious? That's amazing. Deal!
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_reluctant_2: Tch. Alright, you've got a deal.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_reluctant_3: I don't love it, but I'll take it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_reluctant_event_1: Given what's going on out there... fine, I'll take it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_reluctant_event_2: With everything happening right now, I can't really argue. Deal.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_reluctant_event_3: Times being what they are, I'll accept.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_reluctant_aug_3: Affirmative. Compliance is the logical path.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_very_reluctant_1: ...That's a lot. Fine. You've got a deal, barely.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_very_reluctant_2: You're really pushing it. Alright, deal.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_accept_very_reluctant_3: You're lucky I really needed this.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_hard_reject_2: Hell no. Find someone else for that.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_hard_reject_3: You're out of your mind. No deal.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_leave_1: Forget it. I'm out of here.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_budget_increase_1: You just stretched my budget. I can pick up more now.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_budget_increase_2: Saved me some credits, so my budget for today goes further.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_budget_increase_3: That frees up my budget. Show me what else you've got.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_budget_decrease_1: There goes a chunk of my budget. Don't expect me to buy much more.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_budget_decrease_3: That dent in my budget means I'm cutting back on the rest.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_talk_bad_1: Everyone's going to hear what a snake runs this place.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_talk_bad_2: I'll make sure folks know what kind of store you run.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_talk_bad_3: Bad word travels fast around here. Won't be many coming back.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_innocent_blackmail_1: What?! I'm no criminal. How dare you accuse me of that.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_innocent_blackmail_2: I'm an honest customer. Try that nonsense on someone else.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_innocent_blackmail_3: Criminal? You've got the wrong person. That's outrageous.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_false_threaten_1: What the hell are you talking about? I'm no aug.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_false_threaten_2: Aug? You're way off, friend. Better watch your mouth.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_false_threaten_3: I'm clean. Pulling a stunt like that could get you hurt.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_greeting_2: I'm throwing a party tonight. I need supplies.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_greeting_3: A friend said you sell the good stuff. That true?
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_request_1: Drink, smokes, the hard stuff. Whatever you've got.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_request_2: Your strongest vices. None of the cheap stuff.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_request_3: Something to get the party going. Show me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_budget_1: I've got {0} credits. Make it worth it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_wrong_item: Can't get a buzz off that. Don't waste my time.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_hedonist_greeting_1: Long way down from the Upper Levels. Let's be quick.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_bailout_1: Hey. Heard you ain't doing so well.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_bailout_2: I think local businesses like yours are the foundation of our communities.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_bailout_3: So I'm gonna throw some favors your way. No charge.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t1_2: No problem, the price is fine.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t2_1: Acceptable. The cost is not important.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t2_2: That is fine. Funds are not a concern.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t3_1: Price is irrelevant to the objective. Proceeding.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t3_2: Cost parameters are not a limiting constraint. Confirmed.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t4_1: Resource acquisition takes priority over price. This unit accepts.
Dialogue_en.dialog_bargain_aug_accept_t4_2: Monetary value is meaningless. The transaction will complete.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_network_reminder_1: Hey neighbor! Noticed you haven't given me a ring yet.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_network_reminder_2: Give my number a call when you get a chance.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_network_reminder_3: I know all sorts of useful folks.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_network_reminder_4: I can introduce you to people who'll teach you how to farm, clean your water, make wine, and plenty more.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_network_reminder_5: Just dial me up whenever you're ready.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_reminder_1: Say, I noticed your display case is still looking a little empty.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_reminder_4: The more a specific type of goods is worth in your case, the richer the customers it pulls in.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_reminder_5: You should always have both on display.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_reminder_6: Make sure it's all set before you open the shutter door.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_display_case_reminder_7: Anything you add after won't matter until the next day.
Dialogue_en.chem_purity_higher_player: The chemical purity is actually higher.
Dialogue_en.chem_purity_higher_client: Wow, thanks for letting me know.
Dialogue_en.chem_starch_player: Are you serious? This is just Nutrifruit starch.
Dialogue_en.chem_cut_client: Okay, okay, I'll lower the price.
Dialogue_en.chem_near_pharma_player: This is only near pharma grade.
Dialogue_en.chem_client_didnt_know: I didn't know that. I'll lower the price.
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_scam_1: This water's purity is not as labeled!
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_scam_2: What kind of business are you running? This water's purity is off!
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_scam_3: This label's a lie, what kind of scam are you running here?
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_gutterflow: Are you joking? This is clearly Gutterflow.
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_ghostwater: According to my test, this is Ghostwater
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_basewater: According to my test, this is only Basewater
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_water_highquality: This is only High Quality Water. Are you trying to scam me?
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_injector_unusable: This injector is unusable, you can't sell this to me!
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_chemical_pharma_grade: This is Pharma Grade, not Lab Pure.
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_chemical_street_standard: This is just the Street Standard.
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_chemical_junk_grade: This is so impure, even a junkie wouldn't want this.
Dialogue_en.dialog_upper_lower_visitor_luxury_1: What a dull day, so I thought I'd do some shopping.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_1: Hey, rookie. You know everything is negotiable down here.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_2: You can offer Bargains to customers, either by offering them a better price or demanding a better price for yourself.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_3: If you offer a better price to the customer, you'll gain more reputation with their faction while dealing with that customer.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_4: If they're buying, it will also increase their budget.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_5: If you demand a better price from the customer, you'll gain less reputation with their faction while dealing with that customer.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_6: If they're buying, it will also decrease their budget.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_7: Customers will always accept a deal that favors them. But if you're demanding a better price, your reputation affects how likely they are to accept.
Dialogue_en.dialog_mentor_bargain_8: Try it out on the next customer.
Dialogue_en.dialog_sec_arrival_stolen_counter: That's stolen goods on your counter!
Dialogue_en.dialog_sec_arrival_contraband_display: That's contraband in your display case!
Dialogue_en.dialog_sec_arrival_stolen_display: That's stolen goods in your display case!
Dialogue_en.dialog_water_refuse_gutterflow: Are you crazy? I am not drinking this!
Dialogue_en.dialog_water_refuse_rust: I am not drinking this, do you want to kill me?
Dialogue_en.dialog_water_refuse_ghostwater: I'd rather not risk it with Ghostwater.
Dialogue_en.dialog_loan_shark2_intro_8_weeks: You must pay {0} Credits every week for {1} weeks
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_suppressed: Got something accurate? Maybe a suppressed one?
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_reliable_suppressed: I need something reliable, bonus if it's suppressed.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_bigger: I need something intimidating, the bigger the better.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_general_basic: Nothing fancy. A gun that shoots straight and does not jam.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_general_mid: I want a proper sidearm, well rounded.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_general_high: A serious piece, no weak spots. Every detail you get right adds to the price.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_stay_melee: Hold on. Got a melee weapon? I can spend {0}.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_best: Give me your best {0}. I pay what it is worth, and half again on top.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_followup_want_melee: I also want a backup for close quarters.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_handling: I want something that handles well, steady and easy in the hand.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_2: Your recent appraisals have caught the Board's attention.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_3: The Board would like to promote you to {0}.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_4: You will earn a higher appraisal fee on every item, but the Board will expect more accurate estimates.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_items: You will also be qualified to appraise new items.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_accept_1: Congratulations. Here is your new certificate.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_accept_items: And the training material for your new items.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_accept_2: Expect more demanding customers from now on.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_later: Understood. I'll be back in a week.
Dialogue_en.dialog_appraisal_promo_never_1: I see. The Board will not ask again.
Dialogue_en.dialog_scalper_first_1: Word gets around the Black Market. A shopkeeper with Sentinel Collapse Disorder.
Dialogue_en.dialog_scalper_first_2: I got what you need, but the price climbs a little every day.
Dialogue_en.dialog_scalper_2: The price has gone up since last week.
Dialogue_en.dialog_scalper_alldone: See you next week. Try not to die before then.
Dialogue_en.dialog_gun_order_req_service: Can you work on my {0}? I want it to do better. I pay for the parts you put on it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_expose_label_generic: That label is a lie. I'll count it for what it really is.
Dialogue_en.dialog_rev_buyer_2: We are making a move soon.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_return_2: Security held me for two days before they figured out they had the wrong guy.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_return_3: I told you I was the wrong guy and you still reported me!
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_return_4: I just want to buy some groceries.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_return_5: So, are you selling me food this time?
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_vandal_1: Morning! Like the new paint job?
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_vandal_2: That's what you get for reporting me for no reason.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_vandal_arrest_client: Hey, you guys know me. You got the wrong guy!
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted8_vandal_arrest_sec: You are under arrest for vandalism.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted7_plea_1: Wait, wait! Please don't report me!
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted7_plea_2: I can keep bringing you cheap food, I promise.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted7_return_2: Same deal as last time, if you want it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_plea_2: Let me go, and I'll share my formula with you once it's finished!
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_thanks: Thank you. You may have just saved a lot of people from an Oxymore overdose.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_2: My research is almost finished, but I need some chemical supplies.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_3: Security is still looking for me everywhere.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_4: Help me, and I'll share the formula with you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_5: Do you have any right now? If not, I can come back in a week.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_6: The more you give me, the sooner I can finish.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_leave: I'll come back as soon as it's finished.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_finale_2: Thank you for helping me, and for not turning me in.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_finale_3: I'll try to get off the station now and make my research public.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted2_warning_1: Are you sure you want to do that, friend?
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted2_warning_2: Meat this fresh is hard to come by. Somebody always pays for it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted2_warning_3: I bring the meat, you sell it. Nobody has to ask where it came from.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted2_arrest_client: Nobody holds me for long. When I get out, I'll come back for your meat.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted2_arrest_sec: Shit! This guy is huge! Get more people in here!
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted2_return_1: Hello again. I'm back with fresh meat.
Dialogue_en.dialog_sawyer_butcher_1: Hey, I heard you've got a problem with {0}.
Dialogue_en.dialog_sawyer_butcher_2: That guy has been causing trouble for my Crew as well.
Dialogue_en.dialog_sawyer_butcher_3: How about you chip in {0} Credits, and we take care of the problem for you?
Dialogue_en.dialog_sawyer_butcher_4: You can pay through the Nightly Service terminal whenever you're ready.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted3_plea_2: I don't have much to do with the Revolution anymore.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted3_plea_3: If you let me go, I'll put in a good word with the young blood of the Revolution.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted1_plea_2: If you don't report me, I can keep bringing you Security gear.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted1_plea_3: I'm sure you can find buyers who'll pay good money for it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted5_tools_1: I guess tools would do the trick too.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted5_tools_2: Maybe a plasma cutter, or a screwdriver?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_bomb_2: While you were sleeping, I hid a little present somewhere in your stuff.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_bomb_3: It goes boom at midnight. Tick, tock!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_bomb_4: Better find it before you go to bed, Nutrifruit. wink
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_drop_1: Hey Nutrifruit, did you like the "bomb" I left you?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_drop_2: You should have seen your face! chuckles
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_drop_3: Anyway, I've got some errands to run.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_drop_4: Can you keep my box of toys safe for me for a bit?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_drop_5: You'd better not touch anything inside, or else. wink
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_collect_1: Hey, I'm back! Did you miss me?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_collect_2: I'll take my stuff back now.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_peeked_1: Somebody took a little peek inside my box, didn't they?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_peeked_2: Oh, don't look so guilty, you naughty Nutrifruit.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_peeked_3: A girl's allowed to have her little hobbies.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_peeked_4: Maybe next time, I'll show you how they work. See you soon! wink
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_untouched_1: You didn't even take a peek?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_untouched_2: Such a good little Nutrifruit. I could just eat you up.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_taken_2: I told you not to touch my toys, Nutrifruit.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_taken_4: Here's another little present. This one's real. Bye-bye!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_backpack_1: Hello, my friend! Today is your lucky day!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_backpack_2: Georgio got himself a brand new backpack, so the old one has to go.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_2: As you already know, Georgio is the greatest scavenger there ever was.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_3: So why not help out other scavengers?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_4: Georgio now offers his assistance at the Dumping Ground.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_5: Want to give it a try? {0} Credits for {1} nights of help!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_accept_1: Excellent! Georgio will meet you at the Dumping Ground tonight.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_accept_2: Nobody gets hurt when Georgio is around!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_assist_decline_1: No problem, my friend. Maybe next time!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_luck_intro_1: My friend! Georgio is starting a new business!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_luck_intro_2: Georgio is always lucky, so why not sell some luck?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_luck_intro_3: Behold, Liquid Luck! First one's free!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_luck_sale_1: Hello, my friend! So, how did you like the Liquid Luck?
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_luck_sale_2: Georgio has one last batch to sell. Get it while it lasts!
Dialogue_en.dialog_case_enjoyer_1: Alter, do you have anything to open?
Dialogue_en.dialog_case_enjoyer_3: Get as much as you can, I'll come back to buy them in a week.
Dialogue_en.dialog_case_enjoyer_returning_1: Hallo, do you have the crates or keycards?
Dialogue_en.dialog_case_enjoyer_open_1: Alter, let's open one right now!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_letter_1: My friend! Georgio has something for you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_letter_2: Georgio found a young man at the Dumping Ground.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_letter_3: He asked Georgio to bring you this letter. Georgio did not read it. Much.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_officer_return_2: Cadet Serpico has been seen back in the Lower Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_officer_return_3: The reward for him has been raised to {0} Credits.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_rev_2: The evidence is out. The whole station has read it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_rev_3: A few low-ranking officers are facing charges. The ones at the top walked away clean.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_rev_4: So I joined the Revolution. If the system won't clean itself up, we will.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_sec_1: Hey, it's me, Serpico. Back in uniform.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_sec_2: The officer you referred took the evidence all the way to the top.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_sec_3: Officers of every rank are facing charges, the high-ranking ones too.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_sec_4: And I've been transferred to the new anti-corruption task force.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_sec_5: Thank you. Security owes you one.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_2: The Black Market paid well for the evidence.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_3: Enough to get my family out of the Lower Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_4: We're leaving the station for good.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_5: Before I go, I want you to have something. Pick whichever you need.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_rev_1: The Revolution... Working with the enemy?
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_rev_2: But maybe that's what it takes to get through to this station.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_rev_3: Alright. I'll find a way to get it to them. Thank you for hearing me out.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_bm_1: The Black Market would pay a lot for this.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_bm_2: Enough to get my family out of the Lower Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_bm_3: It's not justice, but at least I can keep my family safe.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_choice_sec: [Security ({0} reputation required)]: Hand it to a trusted high ranking officer
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_sec_1: You trust them? It might actually stick. With their name behind it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_sec_2: It's the right way to do it. I'll hand it in tomorrow morning. Thank you, truly.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_1: Hey, it's me, Serpico. Thanks for the food you dropped.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_2: I've been busy since we last spoke. I went through all the evidence I grabbed before I left.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_4: But I can't walk into a Security office with it, and I don't know who else on this station I can trust.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_5: You hear everything from behind that counter.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico7_ask: So I'm asking you: who should I hand this document to?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_accept_1: You silly Nutrifruit, it's me, Lou!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_accept_2: Hahaha, I can't believe you fell for it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_dismiss_1: Haha, not bad. You saw right through my disguise.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_dismiss_2: Sharp eyes, Nutrifruit. Smart and cute? Careful, I might start to like you. *wink*
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_2: This uniform looks good on me, right?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_3: The previous owner won't be needing it anymore. *chuckles*
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_4: Remember my "guest"? He finally opened up to me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_5: He gave me the location of someone I have a score to settle with.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_6: Now, you pocketed my bounty when you called Security on me,
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_7: so I'd say you owe me a favor or two.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_8: Settling this score's gonna take some new toys, and you're getting them for me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_9: {0} Credits' worth of weapons, ammo and meds, and we're even.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_disguise_10: I'll be back in a week. Don't keep a girl waiting, Nutrifruit. *wink*
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_1: Knock knock, Nutrifruit! Did you miss me?
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_2: I'm here for my new toys. Weapons, ammo and meds, {0} Credits' worth.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_3: And don't try to slip me anything funny. I borrowed every scanner Security owns. *wink*
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_wait: Put them on the counter whenever you're ready.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_enough: That's everything I asked for. Good Nutrifruit!
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_short: That's it? You're still {0} Credits short.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_cash: I'll take the rest in cash, then. *wink*
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_cash_all: You don't even have that much? Then I'll take everything in your register.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_even: Well, it was fun playing with you. See you again someday, maybe.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_bomb_1: That's not even half of what you owe me, Nutrifruit.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_bomb_2: And here I thought we were having so much fun.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_bomb_3: Guess I'll settle this score the old-fashioned way.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_demand_bomb_4: Here's one last present. This one's real. Bye-bye! *wink*
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_1: Hello there. You know Eleanor, don't you? I'm her... uncle.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_2: We put together a little care package for her. Only the finest goods from the Upper Levels.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_3: I can't seem to find her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_4: Could you give this to her the next time she comes by?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_5: Make sure it's in her hands. Not yours. Hers.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_6: And if anyone asks, you've never seen me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_7: Oh, and keep Security out of this. Family matters.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_arrest_sec_1: Hello, Shopkeeper. You reported a stolen item?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_arrest_client_1: I didn't steal it! Here's the receipt.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_arrest_sec_2: Then why did you report this item as stolen?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_arrest_sec_3: Filing a false theft report is a crime. You're coming with us!
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_arrest_sec_1: Freeze! That crate was reported stolen.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_arrest_client_1: What? It's not mine! I've never seen it before!
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_arrest_sec_2: Like mother, like daughter. You're coming with us.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_arrest_client_2: Please, someone set me up! Shopkeeper, tell them!
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor6_1: Hey, I've been thinking about what's next.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor6_2: I'm sure someone in the Upper Levels framed my mother.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor6_3: I can't go up there and ask questions, but a private investigator could.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor6_5: So I'll keep scavenging the Dumping Ground and sell you what I find.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor6_6: Give me a fair price, okay? Every credit gets me closer.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor6_to_go: Thank you! Only {0} more Credits to go.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_scav_2: {0} more Credits and I can hire the investigator.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_scav_3: Here's what I found at the Dumping Ground this time.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_scav_enough_1: Okay, I think I've got enough credits now.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_scav_enough_2: Thank you. I'm going to find out who did this to my mother.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_player: *Tell her about the man who said he was her uncle*
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_1: My uncle? I don't have an uncle.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_2: He left a crate for me? One that was reported stolen?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_3: They wanted me arrested. Just like my mother.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_4: I... I need some time to think about this.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_5: But you warned me. Please, take something. It's all I have left from home.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_warned_leave: I'll come back when I've cleared my head.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_2: A data drive, hidden in my mother's old lab at the hydroponics farm.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_3: It's locked, but I know the password. Mom always used my birthday.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_4: I can't wait any longer. Let me open it here.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_6: This is... genetic research. On Nutrifruit.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_7: She found a way to make standard Nutrifruit yield seeds again.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_8: Any decent biohacker could modify it with this data.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_9: No more buying seeds from pastel. This could seriously damage pastel.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_10: That's why they went after her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_11: The embezzlement charges were made up. All of it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_12: pastel's corporate representative on the station set the whole thing up.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor7_13: I... I need some time to think about what to do.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_threat_2: We know you've been in touch with Eleanor. And we know about the data drive.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_threat_3: Tell her to give it back to us, or her mother dies.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_threat_4: If she hands it over, we'll free her mother. She'll be exiled to the Lower Levels, but she'll live.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_threat_5: And if you get her to give it back, there's {0} Credits in it for you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_player: *Tell her about the offer to free her mother*
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_1: They'd free her if I give the drive back?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_3: And if I put it out there, they kill her. But nobody would ever need pastel's seeds again.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_4: I don't know what to do. What would you do?
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_choice_return: [Give the drive back and save her mother]
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_choice_leak: [Leak it to the Lower Levels paper]
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_return_1: You're right. She's all I have left.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_return_2: I'll give it to them. Thank you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_leak_1: You're right. This is bigger than us.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_leak_2: Mom would have wanted everyone to have it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor8_leak_3: I'll take it to the Lower Levels paper today.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_free_2: They exiled her to the Lower Levels, but we're together again.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_free_3: We scavenge the Dumping Ground together now. It's not the life we had, but it's ours.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_thanks: Thank you for everything you did for me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_free_gift: I bought this for my mom's birthday right before this whole thing happened.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_free_gift_2: She won't need something like this anymore.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_free_bye: I want you to have it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_farewell_1: I don't think I would have made it this far without you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_farewell_2: I hope I'll see you again sometime.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_rev_2: They killed my mom the morning the paper came out.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_rev_3: I joined the Revolution. They'll help me make pastel pay, and keep me out of the corporation's reach.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_rev_gift: I bought this for my mom's birthday. I guess it doesn't matter now. I want you to have it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor9_rev_gun: Now, I need a weapon. What have you got?
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_1: Hey neighbor! I heard the news.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_2: You own this place now. Congratulations, that's no small thing down here!
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_3: Now that you've proven yourself a capable merchant, I've got something new for you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_5: Incredibly useful stuff, way beyond anything the industry on this station can produce.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_6: Even the Upper Levels can't get their hands on it easily.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_7: I know a smuggler who deals in it. I can refer you, for a considerable fee, of course.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_8: But I'll warn you: every step of getting those items will be very expensive.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wild_deed_9: Give me a call when you're ready.
Dialogue_en.dialog_hypertech_smuggler_1: Joe Wild sent me. Let's keep this quick.
Dialogue_en.dialog_hypertech_smuggler_2: Here's what I could get my hands on this time. The price is the price.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted6_supply_none: Okay, I'll come back in a week. Please have some chemical supplies ready by then.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_uncle_handed: Good. Her hands, not yours. I'll know.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor3_no_family: I don't have any family left.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_scav_all_done: That's all I have today. {0} more Credits and I can hire the investigator.
Dialogue_en.dialog_water_buyer_filter_inside: Take that filter out first. I only want to buy the water.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_box_gift: And good Nutrifruits get a treat. Go on, pick one.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_favor_choice: [Call in a favor ({0} Lower Levels rep+)]
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_favor_1: For a friend of the Lower Levels? Say no more.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_bail_1: Shopkeeper. A word about the girl we picked up here, Eleanor.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_bail_2: She swears someone set her up. She says you might be willing to post her bail.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_bail_paid: Paid in full. She'll be out by tomorrow.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_bail_vouched: Ok, you've done a few favors for us. We will let this slide.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_bail_declined: Suit yourself. She stays where she is.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_freed_1: Security let me go. They said it was thanks to you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_freed_2: That crate wasn't mine and I don't have an uncle.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_freed_3: Someone wanted me behind bars, just like my mother.
Dialogue_en.dialog_eleanor_freed_4: I won't forget this. Thank you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_offer_1: The young man is very hungry, yes? Georgio happens to have a crate of Nutrifruits.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_offer_2: For {0} Credits, Georgio drops them off for you. You do not have to bring a single bite!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_unable_1: Hmm... but Georgio hears you cannot go to the Dumping Ground these days.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_unable_2: No worries! Georgio happens to have a crate of Nutrifruits.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_unable_3: For {0} Credits, Georgio drops them off for you. Otherwise, Georgio fears the young man will not make it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_accept_1: Excellent! The young man will eat like a king tonight.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_accept_2: A friend of yours is a friend of Georgio!
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_decline: No problem, my friend. Georgio trusts you to feed him yourself.
Dialogue_en.dialog_georgio_serpico_food_unable_decli: Georgio understands. Let us hope the young man finds food on his own.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_gun_drawn: Woah, what's going on? Put that thing away!
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_serpico_1: *turns the body over* Hold on. Cadet Serpico.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_serpico_2: *chuckles* The kid who couldn't keep his mouth shut. The boys are going to love this.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_serpico_3: Now, strictly speaking, that gun of yours is for Augs only.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_serpico_4: But between us? You just saved the department a lot of paperwork.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_serpico_5: We'll write it up as a capture. The bounty's yours.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_rev_arrest_sec_1: Well, look who it is. The cadet turned Revolutionary.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_rev_arrest_client_2: It's already out there. Every name. Arresting me changes nothing.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_arrest_client_1: No... We were leaving tonight. My family is waiting at the docks.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_arrest_sec_1: Then they'll wait a long time.
Dialogue_en.dialog_serpico_end_bm_arrest_sec_2: Good call, Citizen. One less loose end.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_li_1: No augs on this one... hold on. Li Bei Wen? The chemist?
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_li_2: Oh, you did good, Citizen. That man was dangerous. Very, VERY dangerous.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_li_3: Hehe, I'll probably get a bonus from the corporate rep for closing this case.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_li_4: The bounty's yours. We'll take the body.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_wanted_1: Wait. I know this face. {0}, from the wanted list.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_wanted_2: That gun is for Augs, Shopkeeper. Point it at a citizen again and we'll have a very different conversation.
Dialogue_en.sec_shoot_wanted_3: But nobody's going to lose sleep over a dangerous criminal. We'll log it as a capture. The bounty's yours.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted9_vip_2: This is a routine security inspection. A routine one. Very routine.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted9_vip_3: This one is... special. Orders from the top.
Dialogue_en.dialog_wanted9_vip_last_open: So, uh. Open your cargo hold and step aside. Quickly, before my shift... I mean, before the end of my shift.
Dialogue_en.dialog_sec_revoke_shotgun: That includes the shotgun. Hand it over.
Dialogue_en.dialog_sec_aug_all_clear_keep: Your weapon permit covers the shotgun. Keep it, for self defence.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_gun_drawn: Ooh. Careful with that, Nutrifruit. You only get one shot at me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_reveal_2: I know that little toy. Republic issue.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_reveal_3: You could have hidden it in my things. You showed it to me instead.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_reveal_4: They will come for me now. Fine. Let them come.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_reveal_5: I am sorry about before. Now I need to ask for your help.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_reveal_6: I need weapons, ammo, meds. Everything you can spare. Please.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_wait: Put it on the counter. Whatever you can spare.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_more: Good. More, if you have it.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_enough_1: That will do. That will do nicely.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_enough_2: Thank you, Nutrifruit. You will hear from me.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_short_1: It might not be enough. Not to sound ungrateful.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_short_2: It will have to do. Wish me luck, Nutrifruit.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_1: Shopkeeper, my team and I have been tracking a woman by the name of Lou for a while now.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_rep_2: We believe you just met her. She is a traitor to the Republic and a terrorist.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_rep_3: Those regular Security officers will not hold her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_rep_3b: She will come back here, and she will want to play.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_rep_4: She is a psychopath, but a predictable one. Be patient. Play along.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_rep_5: Take this transmitter. Hide it inside something she takes away with her. A box, a crate, anything that leaves with her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_5: When it reaches her hideout, we move in. There is intel in there the Republic needs extracted.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_rep_7: Help us capture her and {0} Credits are yours. Not a word of this to anyone.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_shot_2: The woman you shot yesterday. You are the first person in years to put a hole in her. Congratulations.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_shot_3: She is a traitor to the Republic and a terrorist. And she does not forgive. She will haunt you.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_cooperate: Your best chance is to cooperate with us.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_shot_4: Take this transmitter. She will come for payback. Whatever she makes you hand over, hide it inside.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_shot_6: {0} Credits now, for your trouble. Another {1} when we have her. Not a word of this to anyone.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_reward_1: It is done. We have her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_reward_2: The Republic is grateful. Here's your {0} Credits.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_reward_3: She is going to rot in a black site for the rest of her life.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_fail_1: It is done. We have her. It cost us two good people.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_fail_2: Somehow she knew we were coming. Funny, that.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_fail_3: Your {0} Credits, as agreed. The Republic keeps its word.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_fail_4: Security will be keeping a close eye on this store from now on. Just in case.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_ask_1: You read the news, I take it. An admiral of the Republic, dead on this station.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_ask_2: She did this, and we could have stopped her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_ask_2b: I thought we had a mutual understanding about her.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_operative_ask_3: You are lucky we have to leave soon to track her down, or we would have looked further into your involvement.
Dialogue_en.dialog_lou_trap_credits: I know a weapons dealer around here. {0} Credits would cover the rest.

PhoneDialogue_en.wild1: Hello, This is Mr. Wild's office...
PhoneDialogue_en.wild3: Here's what we can do for you.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep_intro1: Ah yes, Mr. Wild informed us you would call.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep_intro2: I will be your contact at Red Imp Brewery.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep_intro3: Call this number to make an order.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep_intro4: And we will send someone to deliver the next day.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep_intro5: Since you are a new customer...
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep_intro6: We will send you a free sample tomorrow.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep2: Hello, this is Red Imp Sales...
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep3: Would you like to place an order?
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_rep4: Ok, I'll arrange that for you and have it dropped off.
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_out1: I'm afraid we are currently out of stock...
PhoneDialogue_en.red_imp_out2: The next batch should be ready in {0} days.
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_intro1: Lovely! You must be the one Joe mentioned. I'm Ashish.
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_intro2: Just tell me what y'need, and I'll whip it up for ya.
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_intro4: You'll get your stuff next day. No fuss.
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_intro6: I'll send you a free sample tomorrow, my treat.
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_ready: Ok, I'll get it ready for the dropoff.
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_cooldown2: I am busy working on another order
PhoneDialogue_en.ashish_cooldown3: Can you call me in {0} days
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_intro1: So, you're the one Joe sent my way?
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_intro2: The name's Caulson. I run the GP Minin' Coop.
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_intro3: We've got bulk ore if that's what you're after.
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_intro5: -our crew'll come for ya next day. Simple as that.
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_intro7: Since you are new, I'll send you a free sample tomorrow.
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_ready: Ok, I'll get it ready for dropoff.
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_cooldown2: We are all out, I'm afraid.
PhoneDialogue_en.caulson_cooldown3: Call me in... let me see... {0} days?
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_intro2: Call me "Dale", and don't use my name anywhere else.
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_intro3: I... might have access to certain meds from the Upper Levels.
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_intro4: Strictly off the books, of course. We clear on that?
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_intro6: a courier will handle it next day.
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_intro7: Don't follow up unless something goes wrong. Understand?
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_intro9: I'll send you a free sample tomorrow.
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_regular1: You need to place an order?
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_ready: Ok, I'll get it ready for the dropoff.
PhoneDialogue_en.dale_cooldown1: Hi.. I can't take anymore order right now.
PhoneDialogue_en.generic_cooldown: Can't talk right now. Call me again in a few days.
PhoneDialogue_en.odin_crackdown2: Call me again when this Crackdown is over.
PhoneDialogue_en.odin_regular1: Is it you? You have something for us?
PhoneDialogue_en.odin_dropby: I can drop by in {0} days.
