Mechanic_en.event_op_gang_war_news: Gang war In The Lower Levels!
Mechanic_en.event_op_gang_war_desc: Rival gangs has declared war on each other! Shootouts and skirmishes have erupted across the Lower Levels. Expect increased demand for Medical Supplies.
Mechanic_en.event_op_weapon_shipment_desc: A large shipment of illegal weapons has slipped past Security patrols and entered the Lower Levels. Expect a surge in weapon availability and drop in prices.
Mechanic_en.event_op_mob_secret_desc: Reports indicate a minor surge in demands for weapons from secret buyers all over the Lower Levels.
Mechanic_en.event_op_mobilization_desc: Major revolution activities have been detected in the Lower Levels. Revolution cells are making final preparations for a major operation. Expected Weapon, Medical Supplies and Armor prices to surge.
Mechanic_en.event_op_raid_upper_desc: Revolutionaries have launched daring raids in the Upper Levels. Looting goods from homes and businesses to sell in the Lower Levels to fund their operations. Expected increase supply for Household Goods
Mechanic_en.event_op_raid_sec_desc: Revolutionaries have ambushed a major Lower Levels Security outpost. The clashes have led to losses on both sides along with Lower Levels Citizens caught in the crossfire, driving up demand for medical supplies and weakening Security influence.
Mechanic_en.event_op_patrols_desc: Security has temporarily expanded patrols and set up new checkpoints across the Lower Levels. Some Revolutionary and Black Market activities are suppressed, bringing back some order in the Lower Levels.
Mechanic_en.event_op_crackdown_desc: In response to growing concerns over the rise in black market activity and the influx of illegal goods across the station, Command has announced a comprehensive crackdown on contraband. Effective immediately, the enforcement of stricter inspections will be implemented across all sectors.
Mechanic_en.event_op_raid_bm_desc: Security forces launched a surprise raid on black market hubs. Large amount of weapon and narcotic were seized, disrupting illegal trade.
Mechanic_en.event_op_raid_rev_desc: Security has raided a uncovered revolutionary safehouse. The arrests and confiscations has weaken the revolution.
Mechanic_en.event_op_martial_law_desc: Due to recent events, Martial law has been declared across the Lower Levels. Curfews, checkpoints, and surveillance blanket the district. Revolutionary and Black Market activities are suppressed.
Mechanic_en.event_op_budget_increase_desc: Command allocates a major budget increase to Security, allowing additional operations to be launched.
Mechanic_en.event_op_riot_desc: Due to recent event, crowds of Lower Levels citizens erupt into violent riots across the Lower Levels. Shops are looted, Security outposts attacked, and chaos spreads quickly. Food and Weapon are in high demands.
Mechanic_en.event_op_worker_strike_desc: Due to recent events, disgruntled Lower Level workers have gone on strike. Food and water supplies are being disrupted.
Mechanic_en.event_op_medical_aid_desc: Upper Level charities have gather additional medical staff and supplies to the Lower Levels. While some residents remain skeptical, the effort reduces unrest.
Mechanic_en.event_op_food_drive_desc: In a rare gesture of goodwill, Command has distributed rations and food packages across Lower Levels neighborhoods. The initiative eases tensions but some view it as a propaganda tactic.
Mechanic_en.event_op_household_relief_desc: A charity in the Upper Levels has made a generous donation of essential Household Goods to Lower Levels residents. While some remain skeptical of the motives, the aid should helps improve living conditions and settle any growing unrest.
Mechanic_en.event_lottery_draw_desc: {0} is the winning number! Redeem your ticket with your lottery representative! If you have at least 3 matching digits, you win a prize! Good Luck!
Mechanic_en.event_wanted3_desc: In a swift operation by station security, Arthur Lafleur, a known activist and part of the former leadership in the failed revolution attempts of the lower levels, has been apprehended.
Mechanic_en.event_evidence_locker_desc: A daring break-in at the Station's Central Evidence Locker has left Security scrambling. Reports indicate that a crate of confiscated contraband, including key evidence in an active investigation, has gone missing. Security have warned the citizens of the Lower Levels to keep an eye out for suspicious goods entering circulation.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_all_quiet_news: All Quiet In The Lower Levels
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_all_quiet_desc: The Lower Levels have been unusually quiet today, with no major incidents to report. Markets are stable and residents are going about their daily lives.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_electrical_desc: The Upper Levels will experience a temporary blackout as planned electrical maintenance work gets underway.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_nutrifruit_desc: A collective of Lower Levels maintenance technicians have developed a low-cost hydroponic system capable of producing small but consistent batches of Nutrifruit.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_peat_news: How Much Meat Is Actually In PEAT?
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_peat_desc: PEAT, the canned processed meat found in nearly every kitchen in the Lower Levels, is under scrutiny. Independent researchers are questioning how much of the product is actually meat.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_recycling_desc: A small recycling awareness campaign has been launched on the mid-levels to encourage proper waste disposal. The campaign is expected to have minimal practical impact.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_artist_showcase_desc: A local artist showcase is being hosted in the Lower Levels, where residents can view and purchase artwork made from recycled station materials.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_maintenance_strike_desc: A brief strike by maintenance crews has been resolved with no significant delays or damages reported. Normal operations have resumed.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_tech_demo_desc: A technology exhibition has been organized on the Upper Levels, showcasing the latest innovations from startups and tech companies. Most products on display are aimed at high-end buyers.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_transit_news: New Transit Line Opens on Mid-Level
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_transit_desc: A new transit line has opened on the mid-levels, connecting several residential districts to a commercial hub. The improved connectivity is expected to slightly ease commutes for mid-level residents.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_fountain_desc: A new water fountain has been unveiled on the Upper Levels as part of an ongoing beautification project. Security has advised that any citizen caught drinking from the fountain will be arrested and fined.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_garden_desc: Lower Level residents have expanded their community garden with a few new plots for growing basic vegetables. The development is unlikely to affect Food prices.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_art_contest_desc: An art contest held in a mid-level community center invited residents to submit their creations, with the best entries to be displayed in public spaces for a week.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_cultural_desc: An Upper Level cultural group is holding a small celebration featuring traditional performances, music, and food. The event will be mostly attended by Upper Level residents and have little impact on the market.
Mechanic_en.event_cosmetic_spacewalk_desc: A routine spacewalk training exercise for station technicians has been successfully completed with no disruptions to station activities. One man from the Lower Levels is reportedly being treated for shock, after mistaking a spacewalker for an alien.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_nutrifruit_harvest_desc: A large Mid-Level farm is harvesting its Nutrifruit crop. Expect fresh Nutrifruit and lower Food prices for a while.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_bad_harvest_desc: A Lower Level Nutrifruit farm has had a terrible season, with crops failing due to lack of proper resources and maintenance. Expect higher Food prices and a shortage of fresh produce for a while.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_seed_heist_desc: Nutrifruit seeds from hydroponic farm storage have vanished overnight in a daring theft. Both Food and Seed costs are expected to rise sharply across the station.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_counterfeit_med_desc: A large quantity of counterfeit medical goods have been discovered across various clinics and hospitals. Demand for genuine medical supplies is expected to surge.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_water_breakdown_news: Breakdown At Treatment Plant Threatens Water Supply
Mechanic_en.event_normal_water_breakdown_desc: A pump failure at the central Water Treatment Plant is causing major disruption to the water supply. Security has appealed for calm, as market experts anticipate prices for Water and Water Purification Supplies to soar over the next few days.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_water_maintenance_news: Scheduled Maintenance To Proceed At Water Treatment Plant
Mechanic_en.event_normal_water_maintenance_desc: Routine maintenance at the central Water Treatment Plant will proceed on schedule, Security has announced. Disruptions to the pipeline are expected to be limited.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_ice_asteroid_desc: One of our brave mining crews have returned from a successful expedition to the ice-rich asteroid known as "Beira 41-A". Their return is expected to result in an influx of High Quality Water, and lower prices as a result.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_mob_justice_news: Mob Justice in the Lower Levels!
Mechanic_en.event_normal_mob_justice_desc: Fed up with a dishonest shopkeeper, citizens in the Lower Levels are taking justice into their own hands. Station Security have appealed for calm.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_storeroom_desc: A group of scavengers in the Lower Levels have stumbled upon a hidden room packed with household items. A high volume of goods making their way to market will likely lower prices today.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_mining_return_desc: A cohort of miners have returned from an expedition to a mineral-rich asteroid. Material prices are expected to fall for a while.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_construction_desc: Various new construction projects are springing up across the Lower Levels. Construction materials and skilled labourers are likely to be in shorter supply.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_meteor_shower_desc: A meteor shower struck the station last night, causing damage and breaches across multiple sectors. The Lower Levels, lacking a reinforced hull, suffered the most — expect material prices to rise.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_power_shortage_news: Low Power In The Lower Levels
Mechanic_en.event_normal_power_shortage_desc: A faulty power generator has caused a power outage in the Lower Levels. Expect a shortage of energy cells while repairs are underway.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_power_maintenance_desc: Routine maintenance has begun on one of the main power plants in the Lower Levels. Citizens have been told to expect minor disruptions to the power supply throughout the scheduled period.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_blackout_desc: A catastrophic failure in the central power grid has plunged the entire Station into darkness. Expect a surge in demand for energy cells and power-related products.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_cruise_ship_desc: A cruise ship has docked in the Upper Levels, unloading a wave of tourists. It is expected that some curious visitors may even wander down to the Lower Levels. Station Security has appealed for citizens to be respectful during the visit.
Mechanic_en.event_normal_oxymore_desc: A sharp increase in Oxymore use has been reported across the Station, with clinics seeing a surge in addiction and overdose cases. Expect rising demand for medical supplies and treatment services.
Mechanic_en.ins_cig_issues_with: There's an issue with the {0}. You see?
Mechanic_en.ins_cig_confront_correct: Ah yes, I see it now.
Mechanic_en.ins_cig_confront_wrong: Check again, there is nothing wrong with it.
Mechanic_en.ins_cig_georgio_didnt_know: Ah, Georgio didn't know about this.
Mechanic_en.ins_cig_georgio_everything_wrong: Everything is wrong with these cigarettes.
Mechanic_en.ins_cig_talk_genuine_deny: No, it is not. I checked it myself.
Mechanic_en.ins_stamp_confront_correct: Is there? I had no idea.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_rent_desc: As a result of failing to pay your rent, you were evicted. Abandoned by your customers, your contact, and even The Mentor, you are forced to go back to the life of a scavenger. It isn't long before the Store is rented out to somebody new, and you find yourself standing on the other side of the counter, haggling for just a few credits more.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_arrest_desc: For crimes against the station, the Security arrested you. You were locked up in the brig. While serving your sentence, your store was leased to someone else. After your release, with the store lost, you went back to the life of a struggling scavenger.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_execution_desc: For capital crimes against the station, the Security arrested and executed you. After your execution your store was leased to someone else. Your customers quickly forgot about you, and in time, there was no trace of you left on the Station.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_buyout_desc: You sign the deed, and with it, the weight of the rent vanishes, alongside the shadow of the Landlord. The shop is yours, free and clear, a hard-earned victory in a world that's never been kind. For the first time, you stand in control of your future, with nothing but your own ambition to guide you.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_buyout_mortgage_desc: You sign the final papers, and with it, the last chains that bound you to the loan shark are broken. The store is truly yours now, free from the threat of repossession, free from the shadow of the underworld. You've beaten the odds, survived the grind, and come out on top. The future is yours.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_repo_desc: It's the end of the road. The store is taken from you, and with it, everything you fought for slips through your fingers. The loan shark's cold grip tightens as the walls close in, leaving you bankrupt, homeless, and with nothing but a bitter reminder of how quickly everything can be lost in this unforgiving world.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_mob_desc: After one too many offences against the Lower Levels, a mob of angry customers stormed your store. They took everything you owned and you were thrown out of the airlock. This is justice in the Lower Levels.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_sec_desc: Arrested by the Security on some trumped up charges, you were thrown in the brig. The store was seized and sold to pay for a large fine. You were released after a few weeks, but the store was long gone. You went back to the life of a struggling scavenger.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_hitman_desc: After one too many offences against the Upper Levels, a hitman was contracted by the elites of the station to take you out for good.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_sentinel_desc: After skipping one too many Immunivax injectors, your faulty immune system turned on your own body. It wasn't an illness that killed you, it was yourself.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_bombed_desc: After being declared as an enemy of the Revolution, a bomb was planted in your store. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you. The ruin of your store served as a warning to others who would dare to oppose the Revolution.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_cartel_retired_desc: The Cartel decided that you were no longer worth keeping around. You were retired from the business.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_vendor_permit_desc: You weren't able to secure a vendor permit and were forced to close your store.
Mechanic_en.afterhour_items_lost_warning: Items left on the ground will be left behind, and lost. Are you sure you want to leave?
Mechanic_en.afterhour_jackson_warning: Dr. Jackson will send his assistant to retrieve any items you left on the ground. Are you sure you want to leave?
Mechanic_en.afterhour_attempts_wounded: Attempts Remaining: Can't scavenge while wounded!
Mechanic_en.mech_gutterflow_tap: The water line is currently connected to the sewer.
Mechanic_en.mech_rustwater_tap: The water line is currently connected to the industrial discharge pipe.
Mechanic_en.request_meteor_ll_desc: The meteor shower breached a number of areas in the Lower Levels. We have closed down adjacent areas and started repairs on the breaches, but progress has been slow due to lack of supplies.
Mechanic_en.request_meteor_ul_desc: The Upper Levels Community pool was damaged during the meteor shower. It was due for renovation anyway. We are interested in buying a crate of engineering supplies to speed up the process.
Mechanic_en.request_medshortage_ll_title: Medical Supply For Lower Levels Charity Clinic
Mechanic_en.request_medshortage_ll_desc: We are out of medical supplies. Shortages have left many without proper treatment. Any help would be greatly appreciated.
Mechanic_en.request_medshortage_ul_title: Medical Supply For Upper Levels General Hospital
Mechanic_en.request_medshortage_ul_desc: We are experiencing delays in receiving critical medical supplies. While we still have stock, we are willing to pay a premium to ensure our reserves remain well-stocked.
Mechanic_en.request_medshortage_bm_desc: With the ongoing shortage, we are buying up all the supply to drive up the price even higher! Get us the supply and we will pay you handsomely.
Mechanic_en.request_ll_construction_desc: A new housing block is under construction in the Lower Levels, but securing materials has been a challenge. We need supplies to keep the project moving forward.
Mechanic_en.request_bm_construction_desc: The demand for construction materials is rising, and we intend to make sure we control the supply. Get us the supplies before the others do and we'll pay well.
Mechanic_en.request_ll_soup_kitchen_title: Supplies for Lower Level Soup Kitchen
Mechanic_en.request_ll_soup_kitchen_desc: The recent events have left many in need. We can't pay much, but we will make sure to let everyone know of your kindness.
Mechanic_en.request_sec_evidence_desc: A crate of important evidence has gone missing. We need it back ASAP, no questions asked. Deliver it quickly, and you'll be compensated accordingly.
Mechanic_en.request_sec_evidence_requester: Head of Security for Lower Levels
Mechanic_en.request_bm_evidence_desc: A recently stolen crate of evidence contains damaging information against my client. We are willing to pay a premium to secure it before it falls back into Security's hands or worse.
Mechanic_en.request_rev_oxymore_desc: Need some refreshment for our friend's birthday party. It's last-minute.
Mechanic_en.request_rev_scrap_desc: We need scrap metal to build a new garden. The old one's decrepit.
Mechanic_en.request_rev_seccard_desc: We need a housewarming gift for an upcoming friend's gathering.
Mechanic_en.request_rev_peat_desc: We are stocking up our garden for a picnic and need non-perishables. Processed meat is ideal.
Mechanic_en.request_ul_rare_desc: One of our clients has requested this. We will pay well for it.
Mechanic_en.request_ul_charity_desc: We are collecting items for charity to help those in need in the Lower Levels. Any contribution would be greatly appreciated.
Mechanic_en.request_lower_worker_desc: Need something to survive those long shifts.
Mechanic_en.request_georgio_tp_desc: Georgio needs toilet paper for his collection.
Mechanic_en.request_butcher_cleaver_desc: Need a new cleaver. Old one is dull.
Mechanic_en.request_sawyer_beer_desc: My crew's been grinding hard. Time to kick back. Get me some Red Imp Beers.
Mechanic_en.request_lun_snackbar_desc: My favorite snack bar is sold out everywhere. Get me a couple. I'll pay well.
Mechanic_en.request_sawyer_crowbar_desc: Someone has been doing their own cleaning without our permission. We will make an example out of them.
Mechanic_en.request_jackson_energy_desc: Need some energy drinks to stay awake. Gotta finish my experiments!
Mechanic_en.request_landlord_special1_desc: One of my tenants keeps asking me to repair his door. Just get me some scrap metal and I'll see what I can do.
Mechanic_en.request_landlord_special2_desc: An annoying tenant keeps asking me to repair their ventilation. I guess I'll just increase the rent more next week.
Mechanic_en.request_landlord_special3_desc: One of my unit's street windows got broken. I'll just patch it up with some cloth.
Mechanic_en.request_lun_retirement_desc: We are pitching in to get Officer Boucher a nice BBQ party for his retirement.
Mechanic_en.request_upper_petmeat_desc: Acquire some real raw meat, fresh and unprocessed. Only the best for my pet.
Mechanic_en.request_mother_galaxy_desc: I can't believe that Galaxy Blend is the only decent food nutritious enough for a baby around the Lower Levels. Help me get some.
Mechanic_en.water_higher_player: Huh... The water purity is actually higher!
Mechanic_en.water_higher_client: Wow, thanks for letting me know.
Mechanic_en.water_rust_player: This is Rustwater. I can see the particles in the water.
Mechanic_en.water_rust_client: So? Fine, I'll lower the price.
Mechanic_en.water_gutter_player: This is clearly Gutterflow. It's brown, see?
Mechanic_en.water_ghost_player: This is Ghostwater. It's hard to tell, can't be too careful.
Mechanic_en.water_ghost_client: Really? I'll lower the price, then.
Mechanic_en.water_base_player: This is Basewater. Are you trying to pull a fast one or what?
Mechanic_en.water_wrong_pure: I don't have the Credits for Pure Water.
Mechanic_en.water_wrong_rust: Are you crazy? I'm not drinking Rustwater!
Mechanic_en.water_wrong_gutter: Wow, you expect me to drink that?

Mechanic_en.husbandry_cage_desc: A small cage for housing animals. Doesn't look particularly comfortable, but probably nicer than what some people have in the Lower Levels.
Mechanic_en.husbandry_cage_expand_hint: [Use Metal Ingot to Expand ({0} upgrade(s) remaining)]
Mechanic_en.note_ghostwater_threat_1: Stop selling that bogus water, you are killing us!
Mechanic_en.note_ghostwater_threat_2: We know what you did. Stop the water scam, NOW!
Mechanic_en.note_ghostwater_threat_3: Keep on selling tainted water, and you'll regret it.
Mechanic_en.note_ghostwater_threat_4: How do you sleep when you are selling Ghostwater as drinking water?
Mechanic_en.note_ghostwater_threat_5: Stop the Ghostwater scam, or we'll stop you ourselves.
Mechanic_en.note_ghostwater_threat_6: Your fake water is killing us. You're next.
Mechanic_en.note_ammo_threat_1: Your ammo almost got me killed.
Mechanic_en.note_admirer_1: Every day I pass by your shop... one day I'll have the courage to say hello.

Mechanic_en.note_li_formula_s1_body: - Blend a few Dream Caps to get Dream Cap Mush
Mechanic_en.note_li_formula_s2_body:
- Add Alcohol equal to 5 times the volume of Dream Cap Mush
- Heat the mixture to 40-50C to get Dream Cap Extract
Mechanic_en.note_li_formula_s3_body:
- Filter with a Kotton Fabric, then use the Evaporator
- (REQUIRED) All water and alcohol are evaporated
Mechanic_en.note_li_formula_s4_body:
- Add Reducing Agent equal to the Dream Cap Extract
- Add Lipobond Agent equal to a quarter of it
- Heat the mixture to 45-55C to get Nomore
Mechanic_en.note_li_formula_s4_note: WARNING: DREAM CAP EXTRACT WILL DEGRADE ABOVE 60C
Mechanic_en.note_li_formula_s5_body:
- Filter again and evaporate the Lipobond Agent
- Select Nomore Injector in the Chem Finisher

Mechanic_en.note_serpico_letter_body_2: I grabbed some incriminating evidence before I left. I need some time to organize everything, but I'm not gonna make it without food.

Mechanic_en.event_serpico_dead_desc: Cadet Serpico, who was under investigation on corruption charges, was found dead in the Dumping Ground. The Security Department has given no further details at this time.
Mechanic_en.event_serpico_rev_desc: Documents exposing corruption inside Station Security have been published across the station. Several low-ranking officers now face criminal charges. No high-ranking officer has faced any consequence.
Mechanic_en.event_serpico_sec_desc: Evidence handed to a senior officer has led to criminal charges against Security officers of every rank. A new anti-corruption task force has been formed.
Mechanic_en.mech_end_lou_debt_desc: You couldn't pay what you owed Lou, so she settled the score her own way: a little present on your counter, and this one was real. The explosion destroyed the store and killed you.
Mechanic_en.event_lou_admiral_desc: A visiting Republic admiral and his escort were gunned down near the docking bays last night. Witnesses say the shooter, a blonde woman in a stolen Security uniform, walked right up to the admiral's party before opening fire. Officers on the scene hit her several times, but she escaped, and no trace of her has been found.

Biohackers across the station are already growing the new strain, and seed prices have collapsed. The same morning, the former director of the station's largest hydroponics farm, jailed for embezzlement, was found dead in her cell. pastel has declined to comment.

Mechanic_en.event_lou_warehouse_desc: Residents of the Lower Levels reported sustained gunfire from an abandoned warehouse in the old freight district last night. Security found the building rigged with tripwires and, inside, the bodies of several heavily armed individuals in plain clothes, none carrying station identification. UI_en.ins_cig_intro: Counterfeit Hemingway Cigarettes are common on the station. Their value, as their quality, is significantly lower than genuine Hemingway cigarettes.
UI_en.ins_general_discernible_note: The differences should be obvious at a glance.
UI_en.ins_cig_lettering_info: Spelling errors, misaligned text or uneven print quality on the pack, differences in color, font or missing lettering all indicate fraud.
UI_en.ins_cig_seal_info: Hemingway Cigarettes are never sold without a security seal. If the security seal is missing or broken, the cigarette is a counterfeit.
UI_en.ins_stamp_intro: As part of the Republic's very generous welfare initiative, Food Stamps are routinely distributed among the most needy in the Lower Levels. These can be used to buy essential items in stores backed by the Republic. Be warned, however: counterfeit Food Stamps are not unusual in the Lower Levels.
UI_en.ins_stamp_lettering_intro: Look for spelling errors, obvious misaligned text. Differences in color, font or missing lettering are also common in forgeries.
UI_en.ins_stamp_seal_intro: If the Food Stamp has a printed value of 160 Credits or higher, it will have a security seal. Food Stamps under 160 Credits will not have a security seal.
UI_en.ins_stamp_value_intro:
Food Stamps are ONLY issued with values of:
40 Credits, 80 Credits,
120 Credits, 160 Credits,
200 Credits, 240 Credits
UI_en.ins_stamp_chip_intro: All Food Stamps contain a chip. If the chip is missing or damaged, the Food Stamp is unusable, even if it is genuine.
UI_en.ins_inj_intro: A high-precision immuno-regulator developed to temporarily suppress the effects associated with the deadly auto-immune condition Sentinel Collapse.
UI_en.ins_inj_label_intro:
Possible Errors:
 -Spelling
 -Missing Company Name
 -Missing Product Name
 -Significant Font Discrepancy
UI_en.ins_inj_serial_number_intro: All Immunivax Injector MUST have a valid seven-digit serial number. The first three digits are the batch numbers. Valid range: 1250000-4559999.
UI_en.ins_inj_body_intro: If any damaged such as clearly visible cracks can be seen on the injector. It is considered to be Unusable
UI_en.rev_card_proverb: "Power exists to uplift, not to oppress."
UI_en.deed_body:
This document certifies the holder as the lawful owner of the commercial property located at:

Lower Level, Sector 14

This deed hereby grants full ownership rights of the aforementioned property to the holder, effective immediately upon settlement of the debt as outlined in the Deeds of Agreement and upon full payment of the agreed purchase price.

The ownership of the property includes the following rights:

Right to Operation and Management - Full control over, and assumed responsibility for, daily operations and activities.
Right to Renovation or Alteration - Subject to applicable sector zoning laws and regulations.
Right to Sell or Transfer - Subject to approval by the station’s governing authority and in accordance with all applicable rules and regulations.
UI_en.lease_body:
SECTION 1: PARTIES
The Landlord: ("Landlord"),
The Shopkeeper: ("Tenant").

SECTION 2: PREMISES
The Landlord leases to the Tenant for the operation of a commercial business, subject to the terms and conditions outlined herein.

SECTION 3: RENTAL TERMS
Rent Amount: Undetermined        
Payment Schedule: Every Seven Days

SECTION 4: FAILURE TO PAY RENT
If Rent is not paid by the due date, the Tenant shall be granted a one-time grace period during the term of this Agreement. Any missed Rent will be added to the following week’s Rent. Failure to pay the full adjusted amount by the following due date will constitute a breach of this Agreement.

Eviction Clause: If the Tenant fails to pay Rent or the adjusted Rent as outlined, the Landlord reserves the right to terminate this agreement, and initiate eviction procedures as per Station Ordinances.

SECTION 5: RENT ADJUSTMENT
Rent Increase: The Landlord retains the right to adjust the Rent by up to 5% of the current Rent amount for the subsequent week.
UI_en.lottery_intro: The Lower Levels Lottery is finally back! Your fortune starts with a single ticket. Grab yours now!
UI_en.lottery_how_intro: The Lottery winning numbers are drawn every Saturday morning. Winning Numbers will be announced in the newspaper.
UI_en.lottery_system_intro: 6 unique numbers from 1-49 will be drawn. You win prizes based on how many of your numbers match the six numbers drawn.
UI_en.lottery_prizes_intro: 6 unique numbers from 1-49 will be drawn. You win prizes based on how many of your numbers match the six numbers drawn.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_basic_trading_body:
1. Drag the item to the Negotiation Counter and the Negotiation Interface will appear.
 2. A button will appear if you are able to buy or sell the item.

 Clients only have a limited budget to spend at your Store.

You will automatically sell your items with a retail markup.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_food_body:
Food is the most traded commodity on the station.
 Keeping Food in stock is highly recommended, as Food and water prices can rise sharply during shortages. Everyone has to eat.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_afterhours_body:
After closing the Store for the day, you should have time to visit one of the various locations around the Sector.
 You can always return to the Dumping Grounds to scavenge. You won't be able to bring much back to the Store without a backpack.
 You should also bring a bandage to patch yourself up in case you get wounded while scavenging. If you are badly hurt, you won't be able to go out for a few days.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_wholesale_body:
Sometimes sellers offer a discount if you buy all of their items. (This is called buying "Wholesale".)

 You can still inspect each item in the offer individually.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_contraband_body:
Contraband includes any item that is considered illegal by the Republic. The possession or sale of Contraband carries a high risk... and a higher profit margin.
 There are 4 tiers of Contraband:
Low Level (+{0}% Profit Margin): While technically illegal, they are generally ignored by Security unless they are out to get you.
 Mid Level (+{1}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, this item will be seized.
 High Level (+{2}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, this item will be seized and you will receive a fine.
 Critical Level (+{3}% Profit Margin): If found during Inspection, the Store will be shut down permanently and you will be immediately arrested.
 Additionally, you will lose Reputation with Security if any Contraband is found.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_stolen_body:
It is illegal to trade in [Stolen] items. Each stolen item has Heat value, the higher the Heat, the more likely Security will recognize it on inspection. Sellers will offer a discount based on the Heat value.
 Heat slowly decreases over time.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_inspection_body:
Station Security will conduct random inspections for Contraband. Your Reputation with Security will affect the severity of your punishment when Contraband is found. Events can affect how often the Store is inspected.

 Additionally, different Officers will conduct inspections differently. Some may be open to a bribe; others may not search every container.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_appraisal_body:
Some valuable items marked as [Appraisal Item] have complex price structures. Customers will visit the Store and use your appraisal service to determine the value of their item.

 You will receive a base service fee for the appraisal, plus a bonus based on the precision of the appraisal.
You will be able to pass appraisal examinations and receive a certification that will improve your base service fee and unlock new item types to appraise.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_events_body:
Certain events will effect the market price of items, temporarily causing them to rise, or fall. The Newspaper will list most ongoing events.
 Some insiders can sell you tips for events before they happen.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_barter_body:
Sometimes customers will arrive and offer to exchange items, rather than Credits.
 Barter offers cannot be negotiated unlike regular buy and sell offers.
 They are also not impacted by ongoing events.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_display_case_body: On the left side of the Shutter Door, you'll find the Display Case, one of the key features of your Store. Depending on the type of items you place inside, you can attract one client per day looking to buy that type of item. For example, if you put many [Food] items and one low-value [Medical] item, a food-buying client will visit the store the next day. The total value of the items stored will impact the social class of the attracted client. Upgrading your Display Case will allow you to attract more clients. Make sure to stock the Display Case before opening the Store each day. Do not keep Contraband inside the Display Case or you will be arrested.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_upgrades_body:
As the days go by, you will meet various persons of interest who will offer to upgrade your Store for a price.
 These upgrades can be useful, but you must be careful when managing your cash flow and keep an eye out for the next rent payment.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_visual_inspection_body: Certain items will be marked as inspectable using a Magnifying Glass. Use the Magnifying Glass on an inspectable item to open the Inspection Tray. If there's an issue with the item, you can select a reason at the bottom of the Inspection Tray UI to confront the client about it. If the item is counterfeit, one issue is enough to confront the client. If you are right, the client will adjust the price. If you are wrong, you will lose Reputation and the client may take their business elsewhere.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_stamp_body:
Food Stamps are part of a social program to help eligible Lower Level citizens and prevent civil unrest.
 Food Stamps can be redeemed and are used at the Commissary to buy Food.
 Food Stamps can carry various values. Since they can only be used to buy Food, they are often traded at a lower value for Credits.
 The Stamps are sometimes forged and sold to unsuspecting victims, who only find out after failing to redeem the Stamp.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_commissary_body:
The Commissary is run by the Republic. The prices of all items sold here are fixed, and unaffected by the market.

 Nevertheless, while the price of goods is fixed, the availability of items is very much affected by the market.
 Only Food Stamps can be used to purchase goods at the Commissary.

<u>Visit the Commissary after closing the Store to purchase goods.</u>
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_labels_body:
Certain items can be relabeled. For example, you can label a counterfeit box of cigarettes as genuine to raise its price.

 Beware — most workers, Security Officers, and Lower Level citizens are familiar with common item fraud. Scam attempts will fail and result in a penalty to your Reputation.
 While Scavengers are also familiar with item fraud, they often don't carry the equipment required to test for authenticity, if any is needed.
 Tourists and Upper Level citizens, however, are generally less aware.
 But sooner or later, people will find out.
UI_en.intel_mentor_note_scd_body:
I am sorry to hear that you have SCD... It's a serious health condition that you will live with for the rest of your life.
 You will need to take regular Immunivax shots or your health will deteriorate and suffer permanent damage. You can afford to miss a few days at the start, but the damage adds up over time.
UI_en.intel_rev_codeword_body:
The following codewords will be used in Marketplace Requests:
Upcoming Operation, Birthday Party
 Oxymore Injector, Refreshment
 Raid, Gathering
Safehouse, Garden
 Security Access Card, Housewarming Gift
 Extraction, Vacation
Compromised, Decrepit
 High Priority Emergency, Last-Minute
UI_en.intel_rev_codeword_short_desc: An inconspicuous slip of paper with a hastily written key for the code used by revolutionaries.
UI_en.book_ribwich_base_value_body: All Ribwichs start at 150 Credits. Different conditions can affect its price.
UI_en.book_ribwich_intro: A limited edition sandwich from Davre. Now discontinued, it's price now steadily increasing due to people still eating it.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section1_body:
If the plastic packaging is missing, torn open or counterfeit, the final value will always be 40 credits regardless of anything else. 
Ribwichs can't have a final value lower than 40 credits, regardless of any condition.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section2_body: All Ribwichs will have their production date displayed on the packaging. The Ribwich were only ever produced on the following runs:
UI_en.book_ribwich_section2_example:
1st Production Run: January 425 - December 429
2nd Production Run: January 432 - December 438
UI_en.book_ribwich_section2_body4: The Ribwich produced on the very first month (01/425) and the very last month (12/438) are worth +50 Credits for historical reasons.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section2_body3: The first production run Ribwich were made using better material and are worth +80 Credits
UI_en.book_ribwich_section2_body2: If the production date is missing, invalid or outside the range, then it is counterfeit.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section3_body: Davre used a number of facility to produce and package the Ribwich, some are known to have higher or lower quality control standard which can affect the Ribwich shelf life.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section3_example:
High Quality Packing Facility: 01, 02, 05, 08, 21, 34
Low Quality Packing Facility: 07, 15, 18, 26, 31
UI_en.book_ribwich_section3_body2: There's 35 total packing facilities that were used. If the packing facility number is missing or invalid, then the Ribwich is counterfeit.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section3_body3: Ribwich from the high quality packing facility are worth +50 Credits
UI_en.book_ribwich_section3_body4: Ribwich from the low quality packing facility are worth -50 Credits
UI_en.book_ribwich_section3_body5: Example of a genuine Ribwich from the second production run:
UI_en.book_ribwich_section4_body: Ribwich with sesame bun and extra pickles were also released along the normal Ribwich and was marketed as Deluxe Edition
UI_en.book_ribwich_section4_example: The Deluxe edition ribwich must have both the sesame bun and extra pickles. if only one is present then it is counterfeit.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section4_body2: Valid deluxe edition are worth +300 Credits
UI_en.book_ribwich_section5_body: In rare instances, it has been reported that Davre’s packing machine malfunctioned and produced Ribwiches with two meat patties. These Ribwiches are typically removed and destroyed by the quality control team, making double-patty Ribwiches extremely rare.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section5_body2: Valid double patty Ribwich are worth +800 Credits
UI_en.book_ribwich_section6_body: All Ribwich must have the Davre Logo, if missing or incorrect, then it is counterfeit.
UI_en.book_ribwich_section7_body: All 2nd production ribwich will have a Ribwich sticker, if missing or incorrect, then it is counterfeit. 1st production will not have the Ribwich sticker.
UI_en.book_fuel_p1_body:
Plasma Cartridges are the standard fuel of the the Pulse Plasma Drive, a common installation on small-to-medium spacecraft.
A result of high demand and light regulation, Plasma Cartridges are manufactured in sweatshops and industrial laboratories both. Where a Plasma Cartridge is made will affect its quality.

This guide will provide everything you need to know to appraise the value of any Plasma Cartridge.
UI_en.book_fuel_p1_body3:
There are four common manufacturers on the Station:

	- Wild's Rides ("WLD"),
	- Republic Naval Requisition ("RNR"),
	- ZhongHua Shipbuilding ("ZHS"),
	- Ignition Lab ("IGN")
UI_en.book_fuel_p1_body4: Regardless of manufacturer or current condition, Plasma Cartridges have a base value of 300 Credits, and a minimum value of 90 Credits.
UI_en.book_fuel_p2_body: The value of a Plasma Cartridge is determined by its condition. The condition is the total sum of the cartridges attributes.
UI_en.book_fuel_p4_body:
The color of the plasma is the biggest indicator of quality.
Any color not Standard or High-Grade is regarded as Low-Grade.
UI_en.book_fuel_p5_m1_desc:
WLD Plasma Cartridges are manufactured in the Lower Levels, and are highly variable in quality.
Possible Cartridge Condition: Any
Possible Color: Low-Grade, Standard
Seal: Always
UI_en.book_fuel_p5_m2_desc:
ZHS Plasma Cartridges have a more reasonable price point, but without compromising on quality.

Possible Cartridge Condition: None or Reinforced
Possible Color: Standard
Seal: Always
UI_en.book_fuel_p6_m2_desc:
A specialized R&D lab, IGN Plasma Cartridges are manufactured to the highest possible grade.
Possible Cartridge Condition: None
Possible Color:  High-Grade
Seal: Always
UI_en.book_fuel_p6_m1_desc:
Funded by the Republic itself, RNR Plasma Cartridges are typically retrieved and recycled.

Possible Cartridge Condition: Any, Except Cracks
Possible Color: Standard
Seal: Always
UI_en.book_water_s1_body: The quality of water is determined by its purity:
UI_en.book_water_s1_caution: Consume if necessary, prolonged use not advised
UI_en.book_water_s1_unsafe: Unsafe and risky for human consumption
UI_en.book_water_s1_toxic: Warning: Highly Toxic, Do Not Consume
UI_en.book_water_s2_body: Water sold on the station may not be labeled correctly, whether intentionally or not. Always verify water quality before purchase and consumption.
UI_en.book_water_s2_body2: A Water Testing Strip is a cheap and easy way to test the purity of water.
UI_en.book_water_s3_body:
Water on the station can contains multiple types of contaminants. Each method of purification is effective against only certain types of contaminants.

If repeated attempts do not improve the water's purity, your chosen purification method cannot remove the remaining contaminants in the water.
UI_en.book_water_s3_body2: Water Purification Tablets reduce chemical contaminants first, then eliminate microbial contaminants with what remains. One tablet is enough for a large bottle of Rustwater; dirtier water may require several.
UI_en.book_water_s3_body3:
Water Filter: When installed inside a pitcher, it filters water as it is poured in.
It removes impurities, microplastics, and organic waste. Filters have limited durability.
UI_en.book_water_s3_note: Using Purification Tablets and a Water Filter together should bring most water up to Basewater, or even High-Quality Water, depending on the initial purity. Heavily contaminated water may require several tablets.
UI_en.book_water_s3_note2: To reach Pure Water, a dedicated Water Purifier with properly installed Modules is required.
UI_en.book_water_s3_note3: Purifying Gutterflow using basic purification methods is not recommended, as it rapidly degrades Water Filter durability.
UI_en.book_water_s4_body1: Hard to procure even for those living on the Upper Levels. Incredibly expensive and used primarily in sensitive environments like Hospitals and Laboratories. In Upper Levels societies, offering pure water to guests demonstrates high social status.
UI_en.book_water_s4_body2: The standard on the Upper Levels. Safe for drinking, cooking, and most household uses, it is more accessible but still costly.
UI_en.book_water_s4_body3: The standard for Lower Levels. Adequate for short-term use, but prolonged exposure can contribute to development of chronic disease.
UI_en.book_water_s4_body4: Indistinguishable by eye from other higher quality water, yet unsafe to drink unfiltered. Ghostwater is most commonly used in farming and industry. The sale of mislabeled Ghostwater is a common scam in the Lower Levels.
UI_en.book_water_s4_body5: Unsuitable for farming, and dangerous to drink. Can be identified visually.
UI_en.book_water_s4_body6: Heavily contaminated and toxic. Seek immediate medical attention if consumed. Can be visually identified.
UI_en.book_water_s5_a1_body: Rustwater and Gutterflow are harder to mislabel since they are visually distinguishable from other types of water by color.
UI_en.book_water_s5_a2_body: The sale of Ghostwater mislabeled as Basewater is a common scam in the Lower Levels. Selling large volume of mislabeled Ghostwater is a crime.
UI_en.book_water_s5_a3_body:
Scavengers are typically too poor to carry a Water Testing Kit.
Some Citizens of the Lower Levels and Scavengers will not buy Pure Water.
Tourists and Upper Level Citizens are often too oblivious to test the purity of the water they buy.
Customers requesting large amounts of water will typically carry a Water Testing Kit.
UI_en.book_farm_s1_body:
'1. Insert a filled water container with Ghostwater or Basewater.
2. Add some Minerals to make sure there''s enough nutrient.
3. Insert power source and seed.
4. After a day or two, the farm should be ready for harvest.
UI_en.book_farm_s1_note: Add water and replace the energy cell as needed to ensure that hydroponic keep running!
UI_en.book_farm_s2_body:
Start learning hydroponic by farming Nutrifruit. It is genetically modified to be an easy to farm crop.

Make sure to keep enough clean water and add a nutriment tablet to the water when the yield decrease.
UI_en.book_farm_s3_water_body: Certain contaminants can harm the plant's growth. Make sure to use water with a low concentration of contaminants, unless you farming a crop with particular needs. (NOTE: Minerals are NOT contaminants.)
UI_en.book_farm_s3_nutrient_body: Plants require Minerals to grow. Too little or too much can have negative impact on the yield. Each plant has specific nutrient concentration tolerance. Usually, it's better to have too much Minerals than not enough.
UI_en.book_farm_s3_analyser_body: Can be used on a seed to check its needs and their current health.
UI_en.book_chem_p1_s1_body: Can be unpack to obtain various essential chemicals
UI_en.book_chem_p1_s2_body: Use it on liquid container or chemical product to see their composition
UI_en.book_chem_p1_s3_body: Can be upgraded to improve extraction yield
UI_en.book_chem_p1_s4_body: Can be upgraded to improve max temperature, temperature control and heating speed.
UI_en.book_chem_p1_s5_body: Work overnight to remove certain liquid such as water and alcohol. Use normal modules
UI_en.book_chem_p1_s6_body: Can be upgraded to reduce the amount of impurity introduced
UI_en.book_chem_p1_module: Unlike other machines, most of the machine related to chemistry can only be upgraded with the special Chemical Equipment Module.
UI_en.book_chem_p2_s1_body:
- Attach a liquid container to the Blender
- Add a few Dream Cap
- Blend the ingredient to get Dream Cap Mush
UI_en.book_chem_p2_s2_body:
- Take the container from the previous step
- Insert it into the Heating Plate
- Add solvent (Alcohol) equal to 3-6 time the volume of Dream Cap Mush
- Heat the mixure to 40-60C to turn Dream Cap Mush into Dream Cap Extract
UI_en.book_chem_p2_s2_note: Do not overheat or Dream Cap will be destroyed
UI_en.book_chem_p2_s3_body:
- (Optional) Filter the solution from the previous step with a Kotton Fabric as filter to remove large sized contaminants
- Insert the container into the Evaporator
- Make sure the Evaporator is powered with a Energy Cell
- Wait until the next day for the Evaporator to work
UI_en.book_chem_p2_s4_body:
- (REQUIRED) When all the water and alcohol has evaporated, insert the container into the Chem Finisher
- Select Dream Dust as the recipe
- Press the "Output" button 
- (Optional) Check purity with a Composition Spectrometer
UI_en.book_chem_p3_s1_body:
- Attach a liquid container to the Blender
- Add a few Coffee Beans
- Blend the ingredient to get Coffee Beans Mush
UI_en.book_chem_p3_s2_body:
- Take the container from the previous step
- Insert it into the Heating Plate
- (Optional but Recommended) Add solvent (Alcohol) equal to 3-6 time the volume of Coffee Bean Mush
- Heat the mixture to a minimum of 80C
UI_en.book_chem_p3_s2_note: Note: Caffeine is very heat resistance
UI_en.book_chem_p3_s3_body:
- (Optional) Filter the solution from the previous step with a Kotton Fabric as filter to remove large sized contaminants
- Insert the container into the Evaporator
- Make sure the Evaporator is powered with a Energy Cell
- Wait until the next day for the Evaporator to work
UI_en.book_chem_p3_s4_body:
- (REQUIRED) When all the water and alcohol has evaporated, insert the container into the Chem Finisher
- Select Caffeine Pill as the recipe
- Press the "Output" button 
- (Optional) Check purity with a Composition Spectrometer
UI_en.book_chem_p4_body: The precise recipe for Phanta remains a closely guarded secret. What follows is a compilation of publicly available information.
UI_en.book_chem_p4_s1_body: N-Methylol Base is a known precursor of Phanta. It can be found in Restricted Chemical Supplies
UI_en.book_chem_p4_s2_body: The N-Methylol Base will contain a Stabilizing Agent to protect the chemical from degradation but also prevent chemical reaction. It must be somehow removed.
UI_en.book_chem_p4_s3_body:
We now need a substance that can donate electrons to the N-Methylol Base to transform it chemically into Phanta. 

We suspect this process must also be done at high temperature requiring an upgraded Heating Plate
UI_en.book_chem_p4_s4_body: After that, filter the solution and package it as usual.
UI_en.book_chem_p5_body: Some customers will carry Chem Scanner to verify the labeled purity of your products.
UI_en.book_ingot_s1_body: Metal Ingots can be smelted inside a Furnace using TWO pieces of either Scrap Metal or Metal Ore. They can have various levels of purity. The higher the purity, the more valuable the ingot will be.
UI_en.book_ingot_s2_body:
The purity of an ingot is determined by the materials used to smelt it. Using Scrap Metals will yield a lower purity, while using Metal Ores will yield a higher one. Additionally, Flux Agent can be added to the furnace to improve the purity, Any added agent will be consumed.

The Furnace requires a source of power. The smelting process happens overnight.

UI_en.intel_mentor_note_shotgun_body: The Augs are humans overtaken by a rogue AI inside a brain implant. Their bodies are no longer their own, and there is currently no safe way to remove the implant without killing the host. Augs are hostile and extremely dangerous, actively seeking to kidnap people and install more Augmentation implants. Shopkeepers are the first line of defense, since Augs rely on raw materials to fabricate new implants and medical supplies to surgically implant more victims. They haven't fully mastered normal human behavior and may also use overly formal phrasing or robotic vocabulary. Shoot only if you are absolutely certain. Do not try to call Security, the Augs have hacked their comms and will flee before Security arrives.
UI_en.book_water_s1_warning: WARNING: IF CONSUMED GUTTERFLOW, SEEK IMMEDIATE MEDICAL ATTENTION
UI_en.commissary_lottery_redeem_notice: Redeem all winning lottery tickets into Credits (Not Commissary Tokens)
UI_en.ui_clientele_tooltip: Customers will appear depending on the conditions of the Store when the Shutter Door is opened.
UI_en.ui_clientele_normal_tooltip: The condition of your store will attract a number of random customers each day. Certain special items stored in the Display Case can influence which customers appear. Each of the following customers can appear once per day. Remaining slots will be filled with random customers.
UI_en.ui_clientele_merch_tooltip: Most merchandise stored inside the Display Case will attract buyers. Buyers' budget depend on the value of the stored merchandise.
UI_en.ui_clientele_no_merch_detected: No merchandise detected inside the display case.
UI_en.ui_info_variety: This customer will only buy each item once, but will pay a premium.
UI_en.ui_info_no_contraband: This customer will not accept any contraband.
UI_en.ui_info_security_team: This customer is part of Station Security. Showing them Stolen or Contraband items may have consequences.
UI_en.ui_info_service_power: Keeps the store lit and grid devices running. If unpaid, only Machines that run on Energy Cells will function. Lights inside the store will dim.
UI_en.ui_info_service_insurance: If paid, any items stolen during the night will be returned to you the next morning.
UI_en.ui_info_service_janitorial: If paid, the trash can will be emptied and the storefront will be cleaned. If the storefront is left unclean for multiple days, the store's attractiveness will decrease. If the store is currently vandalized, the cleaning cost will be higher.
UI_en.ui_info_store_attractiveness: Store Attractiveness is affected by how recently the Janitor cleaned the storefront, and by certain machines and upgrades.
UI_en.ui_info_reputation: Reputation with a faction can be gained by trading with their members. Trading with special customers grants increased reputation. Reporting a customer to Security may result in lost reputation with their faction.
UI_en.ui_info_labeler: Certain items can have labels, which can be edited. Use this to label items honestly, or to mislabel them and sell at a higher price. Beware: different customers are better or worse at spotting mislabeled goods. If you are caught selling an item worth less than its label, your reputation may take a hit.
UI_en.ui_info_inspection_genuine_claim: The customer claims this item is genuine and in working condition. Use this panel to confront them if you find any sign that it's counterfeit or broken. One issue is enough. If you are wrong, your reputation may take a hit.
UI_en.ui_info_inspection_counterfeit_claim: The customer is selling this item and claims it's counterfeit or broken. If you believe they're wrong, use this panel to say so. They will raise their asking price accordingly and grant you reputation.

UI_en.bargain_ui_offer_discount_info: Offer a discount when selling to this customer. Grants additional reputation on each item sold and increases customer budget.
UI_en.bargain_ui_demand_discount_info: Demand a discount when buying from this customer. Costs reputation on each item bought if successful. Success depends on your faction reputation.
UI_en.bargain_ui_add_markup_info: Charge extra when selling to this customer, reducing their total budget and costing additional reputation on each item sold. Success depends on your current reputation.
UI_en.bargain_ui_offer_markup_info: Pay extra when buying from this customer. Grants additional reputation on each item purchased.
UI_en.bargain_ui_blackmail_info: Threaten to report this customer to Security unless they offer better prices when trading. Always fails on non-criminal customers.
UI_en.bargain_ui_threathen_info: Accuse this customer of being an Aug and threaten to shoot them, demanding better prices when trading. If attempted on a normal customer, the accusation will always fail and you will lose reputation.
UI_en.bargain_ui_rep_mult_info: This multiplier determines the rate at which faction reputation is gained or lost when trading with this customer.
UI_en.bargain_ui_rep_mult_info2: Estimated reputation gained or lost with this customer's faction for every 1,000 Credits traded.
UI_en.book_hand_intro: Cybernetic hands vary widely on the Station, and so do their prices. This guide will help determine the fair market value of any cybernetic hand.
UI_en.book_hand_p1_s1_body: All cybernetic hands start at 100 Credits. Various conditions can affect their price. Regardless of condition, the minimum value of a cybernetic hand is 50 Credits.
UI_en.book_hand_p3_s1_body: Add-ons bonus are independent and each can apply.
UI_en.book_hand_p3_s2_body: Specific combinations of cybernetic hands can increase their value.
UI_en.book_hand_p3_s2_body2:
Tactical:
- Carbon Composite
- EMG+ or Neural Interface
- No wear or damage
- Armored and blade
UI_en.book_hand_p3_s2_body3:
Deluxe:
- Gold Plated
- Neural Interface
- No wear or damage
- With or without any add-ons

UI_en.book_wine_p2_body1: Water quality affects wine quality. Use High Quality Water or Basewater. Pure Water lacks the minerals needed for fermentation. Lower grades of water will greatly reduce wine quality.
UI_en.book_wine_p2_body2: Standard yeast is optional but highly recommended. Without it, wild yeast from the air will ferment the wine instead, producing inconsistent results. Standard yeast also greatly accelerates fermentation.
UI_en.book_wine_p2_body3: Berry quality is the most important factor. One handful is enough for lower-grade wine. Two handfuls are necessary for high-grade wine. Avoid overripe, underripe, or moldy berries. The best berries for winemaking are usually smaller than normal.
UI_en.ui_aug_guide_s2_b1:
-Unnatural Stillness
-Twitching
-Outfit Not Matching Their Faction
-Robotic vocabulary
-Overly Formal Phrasing

The game checks mods before activation, but cannot make them safe. Only activate mods from authors you trust. You use mods at your own risk. Questing Goose Studio and tinyBuild are not responsible for any damage, data loss or other harm caused by a mod, and cannot support problems that occur while mods are active.

RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLREFERAL_desc: {0}% chance that {1} additional random customer will visit the Store per day.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLREFERAL_flavor: Word travels fast in the Lower Levels. A satisfied customer is more than just a sale, they're your best advertisement.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLTIPS_desc: You will occasionally receive tips from the Lower Levels about upcoming events.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLTIPS_flavor: The people of the Lower Levels have their ears to the ground. If they trust you, they'll keep you in the loop, too.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_desc: New types of customers offering Rare or Contraband goods will start to visit your Store.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLRAREGOOD_flavor: With the right connections, even the Lower Levels can offer up something worth your while.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_desc: Selling Contraband to customers from the Lower Levels will only create {0:P0} of its value in available evidence.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLTIGHTLIPS_flavor: You've earned their trust. They know you're good for it, and they're not going to rat you out.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLPILLAR_desc: You will now receive {0}% discount from Joe Wild and Dr. Jackson.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLPILLAR_flavor: You've earned the respect of the Lower Levels. Even other Lower Levels leaders recognize the good you do.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_desc: {0}% chance that {1} less random customer will visit your Store per day.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLPOORREVIEWS_flavor: All it takes is a few dissatisfied customers, and your Reputation in the Lower Levels takes a hit.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_desc: Customers from the Lower Levels will no longer sell you Contraband items.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLDISTRUSTED_flavor: You are known throughout the Lower Levels as a liability. Those with contraband to sell will take it elsewhere.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLTARGET_desc: You will be targeted more frequently by thieves. Insurance will now cost {0}x.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLTARGET_flavor: Your poor reputation has put a target on your back. The Lower Levels never forget.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_desc: All suppliers will refuse to take your calls. Dr. Jackson will no longer visit your Store, except under special circumstances.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLAVOIDED_flavor: No one want to associate with you anymore. Fearing for their own reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLLYNCH_desc: A mob from the Lower Levels will attack your Store and lynch you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_LLLYNCH_flavor: The people of the Lower Levels have had enough, they'll take matters into their own hands.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_desc: A Security Requisition Officer will occasionally visit your Store to purchase Food and Medical Supplies. Trading with them will increase your Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_REQUISITION_flavor: Even Station Security has to get their supplies from someone. They will pay you a fair price.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_desc: Security will not longer respond to your alarms.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_ALARM_IGNORED_flavor: You've cried wolf one too many times, or maybe you're just not worth the trouble anymore. Either way, when things go south, you're on your own.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_desc: Security has added you on their watchlist. Any investigation on you will progress x{0} times faster.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_WATCHLIST_flavor: Your notoriety has caught the eye of Station Security. Keep your head down, or lose it.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_desc: Any investigation on you will progress x{0} times faster.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_PRIORITY_flavor: Another day, another case file with your name on it on the desk of the Head of Station Security...
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_desc: Security will no longer sent you lazy or shady inspectors. Additionally, inspections will be more frequent.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_THOROUGH_INSPECTION_flavor: No more easy passes or conveniently blind inspectors. Every visit is now a full sweep.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_desc: Security will prosecute you to the maximum extent of the law regarding contraband found during inspection.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_CONTRABAND_TOLERANCE_flavor: No more warnings. No more bribes. Even the smallest contraband could land you in serious trouble.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_desc: Security will immediately arrest and jail you, regardless of any evidence they have (or don't have).
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_IMMEDIATE_ARREST_flavor: When they want you gone, the truth doesn't matter. They'll make sure the "evidence" says exactly what they need it to.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_desc: Due to your good Reputation with Security, Thieves are more reluctant to target your Store.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_PROTECTION_flavor: Having the eyes of Station Security on you isn't always a bad thing.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_desc: A Security Surplus Merchant will occasionally visit the Store.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_SURPLUS_flavor: Station Security has agreed to sell you their decommissioned equipment, including weapons and armor.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_desc: The Security Surplus Merchant will have improved wares, and Security customers will have {0}% more credits to spend.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_RELIABLE_VENDOR_flavor: You've proven yourself to be a reliable vendor. Station Security is willing to do more business with you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_VIP_desc: Due to your excellent Reputation with Security, Thieves will no longer target your Store. You will no longer be subject to inspection.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_VIP_flavor: You're untouchable. Security has your back, and they're not going to let anyone mess with you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_desc: Inspections will be less frequent, and any investigations will progress slower. You will receive advanced warning of any impending Security Operation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_SEC_TRUSTED_flavor: Being trusted means less hassle from Security. Inspections are now few and far between.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_desc: You will receive advanced notice of most Black Market events.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_NETWORK_flavor: It's who you know that matters.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_desc: Customers from the Black Market will no longer sell you Contraband items. You are barred from the Underground Exchange. The Janitorial Service cost double.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_DISTRUSTED_flavor: Your credits aren't worth a thing if nobody trusts you enough to sell.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_desc: Insurance services will not longer be available to you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_UNINSURABLE_flavor: Due to your infamy with the Black Market, even Joe Wild can't insure you anymore. You're on your own now.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_desc: Petty Thieves have an increased chance of visiting your Store. Their wares will now improve with higher Black Market Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_SMALL_TIME_BROKER_flavor: You are starting to build a reputation with the Black Market.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_HONOR_desc: Reputation is lost with the Black Market at a rate of x{0}, regardless of your current Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_desc: You are guaranteed a visit from a Thief once per week. All thieves will now offer improved wares.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_BM_RELIABLE_flavor: The Thieves of the Black Market know you're good for it, and more are willing to deal with you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_desc: You will receive advanced notice of most Upper Levels events.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_GOSSIP_flavor: They never stop talking up there... sometimes they even say something useful.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_TIPS_desc: You will receive {0}% bonus when selling items to customers from the Upper Levels.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_TIPS_flavor: They don't haggle. They just drop a few extra credits and call it etiquette.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_desc: A benefactor from the Upper Levels will occasionally donate goods to your Store.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_CHARITY_flavor: Publicity stunts or genuine kindness? You won't argue with free goods.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_desc: You have {0}% chance of receiving {1} additional daily customer from the Upper Levels.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_HOUSEHOLD_NAME_flavor: Your Store has become the talk of the Upper Levels.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_desc: All customers from the Upper Levels have {0}% more credits to spend.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_TOP_REVIEW_flavor: Your Store is the worst kept secret in the Upper Levels. Customers from the Upper Levels are willing to spend more when they visit.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_desc: Customers from the Upper Levels are less likely to visit your Store.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_TOURISTTRAP_flavor: Upper Levels clients expect better. Lately, you're not delivering.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_PETITION_desc: You lose Reputation with Security {0}x faster and active investigations progress {1:P0} faster.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_PETITION_flavor: Using their influence, the Upper Levels have petitioned Security to keep a closer eye on you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_desc: A hit will be immediately placed on you by the Upper Levels.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_HITMAN_flavor: A contract has been signed in a luxury suites above. You've made the wrong enemies.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_desc: You will receive advanced notice of most Revolution events.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_FRIEND_flavor: The revolution will make sure you are not caught in the crossfire.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_HIT_desc: A revolution hit squad will be immediately tasked with eliminating you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_HIT_flavor: You have been declared an enemy of the revolution. They will stop at nothing to see you gone.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_desc: Customers sympathetic to the Revolution are less likely to visit your Store.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_BLACKLISTED_flavor: Notice has been circulated among revolutionary cells, warning members to avoid doing business with you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_desc: You will occasionally receive Marketplace Requests from various Revolution cells.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_REQUEST_flavor: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_desc: Members of the Revolution will occasionally visit to sell off their loot from raids. Prices will improve with higher Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_RAID_LOOT_flavor: The liberation of people requires the liberation of supplies.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_desc: A Revolution Quartermaster will occasionally visit your Store to sell Materials at a discount. The discount will improve with higher Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_REV_QUARTERMASTER_flavor: Revolutions can't run on ideals alone. The Quartermaster sells cheap stock to quietly fund the next move.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_desc: A Cartel Hitman has been dispatched to eliminate you.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_RETIRED_flavor: Sometimes what is best for the dog is to put it down.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_desc: Your weekly stipend now scales with your Cartel Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_INCREASED_STIPEND_flavor: Don't mistake it for kindness, it's an investment.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_desc: Requesting additional Materials now costs {0}% of the usual Reputation.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_RELIABLE_CHEMIST_flavor: The Cartel will reward consistency, and service.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_desc: Your handler will start to process your authorized exit from the Cartel.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_CARTEL_AUTHORIZED_EXIT_flavor: You're lucky, not many get to leave without a body bag...
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_desc: While a Luxury Item is in your display case, you have {0}% chance each day of receiving an additional customer looking to buy Luxury Items. Rises with Reputation. This customer can only visit once every {1} days.
RepPerkTable_en.rep_perk_UL_DISCERNING_TASTE_flavor: Something expensive in a Lower Levels window? The Upper Levels will come down just to say they found it first.

NewGame_en.generalist_body: During your training with The Mentor, no particular specialization piqued your interest. Instead, you spent more time optimising your operation, resulting in less money spent setting up the store.
NewGame_en.generalist_gear3: Start with a stock of Household Goods and Food
NewGame_en.water_merchant_body: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in learning about the Water trade. Clean water is a scarce resource on the station and there is money to be made by those with their hands on the tap.
NewGame_en.junker_body: Before The Mentor found you, you were a scavenger, poor but with solid reputation. Despite your training, you never forgot your past, and have even repurposed your old equipment for your new occupation.
NewGame_en.fence_body: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in contraband. You're an established black marketeer, and have even installed a hidden storage compartment in your store to avoid the prying of the station's security.
NewGame_en.fence_gear2: Start with a stock of Contraband
NewGame_en.fence_gear5: Immediate access to the Janitor Underground Exchange
NewGame_en.moonshiner_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a taste for moonshine. You know how to trade, appraise and even brew your own liquor. Moonshine is popular in the Lower Levels due to its low cost, but it is also unregulated and illegal.
NewGame_en.chemist_body: During your training with The Mentor, you acquired a nose for narcotics. You are an expert in the illegal, addictive and lucrative trade of controlled substances. You're not bad in the lab, either, should supply run low.
NewGame_en.organ_trader_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a grim fascination in the trade of human organs. Certified, ethically sourced organs are legal to trade... but there is more money to be made in illicit stock harvested from living patients.
NewGame_en.pharmacist_body: During your training with The Mentor, you took a particular interest in over-the-counter medicines. You learned about the basics of running a pharmacy, helping sick customers and synthesizing drugs.
NewGame_en.pharmacist_gear3: Start with a stock of Medical Supplies
NewGame_en.street_food_vendor_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed a passion for cooking and street food. You know how to prepare quick, flavorful meals that cater to the busy residents of the lower levels. Operating a street food stall is a popular and flexible way to make a living, and with the right ingredients, you can turn a tidy profit.
NewGame_en.street_food_vendor_gear3: Start with a stock of Ingredients
NewGame_en.hydroponic_farmer_body: During your training with The Mentor, you refined your knowledge of hydroponic farming, an efficient way to grow crops in the limited space available on the station. With your expertise, you can help feed the lower levels while making a handy profit.
NewGame_en.hydroponic_farmer_gear3: Start with a stock of Farming Supplies and Seeds
NewGame_en.gunsmith_body: During your training with The Mentor, you developed an enthusiasm for firearms and munitions. You learned how to modify weapons, from handmade sidearms to powerful machine guns. With a license in hand, you now fulfill custom orders and earn a steady income arming the residents of the station.
NewGame_en.gunsmith_gear2: Start with a stock of Firearms and Gun Mods
NewGame_en.gunsmith_gear3: Start with a stock of Ammunition
NewGame_en.rock_bottom_body: The Mentor didn't help you with anything aside from negotiating your lease with the Landlord. You have nothing but the Store, and a will to survive.
NewGame_en.rancher_body: To the Mentor's annoyance, you developed a great passion for animal ranching. Rats, more specifically. You've learned the basics of raising rats for meat.
NewGame_en.welcome_main:
You're a shopkeeper in the Lower Levels of a sprawling space station. Once a poor scavenger, you were taken in by a mysterious figure known as the Mentor, who fronted you a generous loan and taught you the basics of running a shop. His true motives remain unclear.
Now you must meet the Landlord's unrelenting demands or face eviction. Turn a profit, secure a mortgage, and buy the shop to carve out your place on the station.
 Survive at any cost. Earn your future.
NewGame_en.aquafarmer_body: During your training with The Mentor, you learned to raise fish in tanks for meat. You start with a small recirculating system and a stock of starter fish.
NewGame_en.aquafarmer_gear2: Start with a stock of Tilapia and Fish Food

Interactable_en.door_too_late: It's too late to go anywhere now...
Interactable_en.door_day_not_over: You can't leave the Store until the day is over!
Interactable_en.door_crackdown: You can't leave the Store during a crackdown!
Interactable_en.door_wounded: You can't leave the Store while you have major wounds!
Interactable_en.door_agoraphobia: You can't leave the store due to your agoraphobia!
Interactable_en.door_agoraphobia_rest: Your agoraphobia keeps you in the Store! Rest here {0} more nights before going out again.
Interactable_en.door_agoraphobia_rest_last: Your agoraphobia keeps you in the Store! You can go out again tomorrow.

PerkTable_en.perk_bad_lease_desc: Your starting rent is increased by {0} Credits.
PerkTable_en.perk_convict_desc: Start with an additional {0} Security Reputation and will receive {1}% less reward for reporting customers on the Wanted List.
PerkTable_en.perk_model_citizen_desc: Start with an additional +{0} Security Reputation and will receive {1}% more reward for reporting customers on the Wanted List.
PerkTable_en.perk_well_connected_desc: Start with an additional {0} Reputation with all factions.
PerkTable_en.perk_alert_desc: You will never get robbed during the night.
PerkTable_en.perk_sawyer_crew_desc: The Underground Exchange is available from the start. Janitorial Service is always free,  unless the Store is vandalized. Vandalism clean up cost is significantly reduced.
PerkTable_en.perk_diplomatic_desc: Reputation generated from trade is increased by {0}%.
PerkTable_en.perk_intimidating_desc: All committed crimes generate {0}% less available evidence.
PerkTable_en.perk_side_street_desc: You get one less random customer per day.
PerkTable_en.perk_nicotine_addiction_desc: You will suffer a trade penalty of {0}% if you don't consume nicotine regularly. The addiction can be cured.
PerkTable_en.perk_narcotic_addiction_desc: You will suffer a trade penalty of {0}% if you don't consume narcotics regularly. The addiction can be cured.
PerkTable_en.perk_alcohol_addiction_desc: You will suffer a trade penalty of {0}% if you don't consume alcohol regularly. The addiction can be cured.
PerkTable_en.perk_secret_admirer_desc: You will occasionally receive random items from a secret admirer when opening the Store.
PerkTable_en.perk_colorful_character_desc: Allows you to have {0} additional starting perk slots.
PerkTable_en.perk_blackmail_desc: You have a questionable past and a blackmailer is threatening to expose your secret. You will have to pay them a small weekly fee or they will expose you,  leading to a major one-time loss to your reputation across most factions.
PerkTable_en.perk_blabbermouth_desc: All committed crimes generate {0}% more available evidence. You will gain 50% less reputation with the Black Market and the Revolution.
PerkTable_en.perk_unsubscribed_desc: You will not receive the daily newspaper that informs you about ongoing events.
PerkTable_en.perk_minimalist_desc: Your main inventory is reduced 20x10 instead of 24x10.
PerkTable_en.perk_sentinel_desc: You suffer from a deadly, incurable auto-immune condition and must take a weekly Immunivax injection to stay alive. Start the game with 1 Immunivax Injector.
PerkTable_en.perk_speedy_desc: You can visit up to 2 after-hours locations every night.
PerkTable_en.perk_welfare_program_desc: The Commissary is available from the start.  On Mondays, you may receive Food Stamps depending on your total wealth.
PerkTable_en.perk_proficient_scavenger_desc: You can perform up to 2 additional Search actions in the Dumping Grounds every time you visit.
PerkTable_en.perk_revolution_sympathizer_desc: Start with an additional {0} Reputation with The Revolution. You will receive Marketplace Requests from The Revolution more frequently.
PerkTable_en.perk_gambling_addiction_desc: You will always buy some Lottery Tickets when possible. All lottery content is unlocked from the start. The addiction can be cured.
